                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The Planning Commission / NITI AAYOG: key facts from the book
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Planning Commission was established by an executive resolution of the Government of India on 15 March, 1950.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • It was neither a Constitutional body nor a statutory body.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • It was established on the recommendation of an advisory planning board chaired by K.C. Neogy. Prime Minister used to be its ex-officio chairman.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • First Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission was Guljari Lal Nanda.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Its main function was to assess the resources of the country and prepare five-year plans for the central government for balanced utilisation of those resources.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Planning Commission was replaced by 'NITI Aayog' on 1 January, 2015.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • NITI refers to the Nation al Institution for Transforming India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The current Vice Chairman of NITI Aayog is Dr. Suman K. Bery.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Its Chief Executive Officer is B.V.R. Subrahmanyam.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The rank and status of its vice-chairperson is equivalent to a Cabinet Minister.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The National Development Council was established on 6 August, 1952.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Planning Commission has been abolished by Prime MinisterNarendra Modi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Planning Commission (March 1950, Nehru) → abolished by PM Narendra Modi (announced 15 August 2014); NITI Aayog set up 1 January 2015 by Union Cabinet resolution. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who appoints the Vice Chairman of NITI Aayog?The Prime Minister of India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NITI Aayog Vice-Chairperson → appointed by the Prime Minister (Cabinet Minister rank); first was Dr. Arvind Pangariya (January 2015 to August 2017); PM is ex-officio chairman. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which among the following is not a part of the Governing Council of NITI Aayog?Governors of States

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NITI Aayog Governing Council → PM (chair), CMs of all States, CMs of Delhi and Puducherry, Lt. Governors of other UTs; Governors of States not included.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • When was the Planning Commission established?15th March, 1950

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Planning Commission → set up 15 March 1950 by Union Cabinet resolution (non-constitutional). NITI Aayog → also extra-constitutional, from 1 January 2015. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following is not a Constitutional body?Planning Commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Planning Commission → not a constitutional body (executive order, 1950). UPSC and State PSCs (Art 315) and Finance Commission (Art 280) are constitutional. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 8 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following body/bodies does not/do not find mention in the Constitution?All of these

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Not in the Constitution → National Development Council (1952) and Planning Commission (1950), both by executive order; Zonal Councils, statutory (States Reorganisation Act, 1956).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who was the First Chairman of Planning Commission of India?Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        First Chairman of Planning Commission → Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru, as the Prime Minister was its ex-officio Chairman (set up 15 March 1950). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following is not correct about NITI Aayog?It has a full-time Chairman

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NITI Aayog → came 1 January 2015 to replace Planning Commission; works on cooperative federalism; has no full-time Chairman (PM is ex-officio Chairperson).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse The false statement is 'full-time Chairman'; the PM heads it ex officio.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who among the following is associated with ‘NITI’ Aayog”?Narendra Modi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NITI Aayog → Chairperson is Narendra Modi, as the Prime Minister is its ex-officio Chairman; set up 1 January 2015 in place of Planning Commission.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission is equivalent to-Cabinet Minister

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Deputy Chairman of Planning Commission → rank of a Cabinet Minister; first Deputy Chairman was Gulzarilal Nanda. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who among the following has not been the Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission in India?P. Chidambaram

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Never Deputy Chairman of Planning Commission → P. Chidambaram. Were: Dr. Manmohan Singh (1985-1987), Pranab Mukherjee (1991-1996), Montek Singh Ahluwalia (2004-2014).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Given below are two statements, one labelled as assertion (A) and the other labelled as Reason (R):Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Planning Commission → called 'Economic Cabinet' of Union and States (extra-constitutional powers, wide scope); it formulated five-year plans; both true, but R does not explain A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who had suggested a merger of Finance and Planning Commision?M.V. Mathur

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Merger of Finance Commission and Planning Commission → suggested by M.V. Mathur, a member of the 3rd Finance Commission (1960).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • When was the National Development Council formed in India?6th August, 1952

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        National Development Council (NDC) → formed 6 August 1952.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following statements in not true?Planning Commission is the highest decision-making body for planning in India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Wrong statement: Planning Commission was the highest planning body. Apex body → National Development Council, presided by PM; Planning Commission Secretary is NDC Secretary.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The National Development Council (NDC) –1, 2, and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NDC → gives guidelines for the National Plan, considers it, reviews progress and suggests ways to meet its goals; allocating money was the Planning Commission's job. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who among the following constitutes the National Development Council?Only 1, 3 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NDC members → PM (Chairman), Union Cabinet ministers, CMs of all states, CMs/Administrators of UTs, Planning Commission (NITI Aayog) members; not the Finance Commission Chairman.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • National Development Council is primarily related to –Approval of five-year plans

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NDC → final approval of five-year plans; set up 6 August 1952 by executive order; PM presides; Planning Commission Secretary is its Secretary; coordinates Planning Commission and States. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following statement is not correct about 'National Development Council'?It is a statutory body.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        NDC → non-constitutional and non-statutory (so 'statutory body' is wrong); meets at least twice a year; PM heads it; CMs of all states are members.
