                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Lokpal and Important Commissions: key facts from the book
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The earliest democratic institution created in the world for the redressal of citizens' grievances is the Scandinavian institution of Ombudsman.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The institution of the Ombudsman was first created in Sweden in 1809. In order to meet the long-standing demand to establish a mechanism for dealing with complaints on corruption against certain public functionaries, the Indian Democratic system proposed the establishment of Lokpal at the centre and Lokayukta at the State level.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In its interim report dated 20th October, 1966, under the Chairmanship of Morarji Desai, the First Administrative Reforms Commission (1966- 1970) recommended the setting up of Lokpal and Lokayuktas. Later in the year 1967, K. Hanumanthaiah became its Chairman.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Bills regarding Lokpal were first introduced in the year 1968, in the Parliament (in the 4th Lok Sabha).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • However, on 20th August, 1969, the first Jan Lokpal Bill was passed in the Fourth Lok Sabha. In the year 1972, Maharashtra became the first State to establish the institution of Lokayukta. The Lokayukta Act of Maharashtra was enacted on 30 November, 1971 and it came into effect on 25th October, 1972.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Although Odisha had passed the Act in this regard in 1970, it came into force in 1983.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • According to the Uttar Pradesh Lokayukta Act 1975, the Lokayukta submits his report to the Governor.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Governor presents this report in both Houses of the State Legislature. Institution of Lokpal has been established for the first time in India by 'The Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013'. The Lokpal consists of a chairperson and not more than eight members. Former Justice Pinaki Chandra Ghose was appointed India's first Lokpal.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In the year 1993, the Vohra Committee was setup to study the problem of the criminalisation of Politicians and bureaucrats in India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Rajamannar Committee recommended the abolition of Indian Administrative Services and Indian Police Services. In the year 1993, the then- President exercised his powers under Article 123 and promulgated the Protection of Human Rights Ordinance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • As a result, the Protection of Human Rights Act came into force on 28th September 1993.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The National Human Rights Commission is a statutory (non constitutional) body. This organization was established on 12th October 1993. Its Chairman and members are appointed by the President, on the recommendations of a 6-member committee consisting of the Prime Minister as its head, the speaker of the Lok Sabha, the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha, the Leader of the Opposition in both Houses of the Parliament and the Home Minister.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Function of the Commission is mainly recommendatory in nature. The Protection of Human Rights (Amendment) Act, 2019 amended the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993. Some major amendments are -

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              (i) The Act provides that a person who has been the Chief Justice of India, or a judge of the Supreme Court will be the chairperson of the NHRC.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              (ii) The Act provides for three persons (of which at least one will be a woman) having knowledge of or practical experience in matters relating to human rights to be appointed as the members of the NHRC.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              (iii) The Act reduces the term of office of the chairman and members of the NHRC and SHRC to three years or till the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The chairperson and members of the State Finance Commission are appointed by the Governor.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Central Information Commission was established by an official Gazette Notification under the provisions of the Right to Information Act 2005. According to the Right to Information Act, 2005 the term of the Chief Information Commissioner was up to 5 years or 65 years of age. According to the Right to Information (Amendment) Act, 2019 the tenure of the Chief Information Commissioner and other Information Commissioners will be determined by the Central Government. In addition to the central and state level, Chief Information Commissioner and other information commissioners will receive the same salary, allowance and other facilities as the Central Government determines.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In the year 1979, under the Chairmanship of Bindeshwari Prasad Mandal, the Mandal Commission was established.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The main task of this Commission was to identify and recommend steps for the advancement of the socially and educationally backward classes of India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Article 315 of the Indian Constitution deals with the establishment of Public Service Commission for the Union and for the States.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Union Public Service Commission consists of a Chairman and other Members appointed by the President of India, whereas the Chairman and Members of the State Public Service Commission are appointed by the Governor of the State.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • According to Article 323, the UPSC presents annually, to the President, a report on its performance, whereas the SPSCs present annually, to the Governor a report on their performance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • According to Article 322, the expenses of the Union or a State Public Service Commission shall be charged on the Consolidated Fund of India or the Consolidated Fund of State (in case of SPSCs).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • According to the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013 the Lokpal would be appointed by the President after obtaining the recommendations of a Selection Committee, with the Prime Minister as chairperson and consisting, among others, of the following:1, 3 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Lokpal Selection Committee (Act 2013) → PM (chair), Lok Sabha Speaker, Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha, CJI or his nominee SC judge, one eminent jurist; no Rajya Sabha Chairman.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid Only Lok Sabha figures sit on it: Lokpal goes with Lok Sabha.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements regarding Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013:Only 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013 → no Rajya Sabha Chairman on Selection Committee (1 false); applies to public servants within and outside India [Sec 1(3)] (2 true).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements about Lokpal: I. The power of Lokpal applies to public servants of India, but not to the Indian public servants posted outside India. II. The Chairperson or a Member shall not be a Member of the Parliament or a Member of the Legislature of any State or Union Territory, and only the Chief Justice of India, whether incumbent or retired, has to be its Chairperson. III. The Chairperson or a Member shall not be a person of less than forty-five years of age on the date of assuming office as the Chairperson or Member, as the case may be. IV. Lokpal cannot inquire into the allegations of corruption against a sitting Prime Minister of India. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?III only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Lokpal Chairperson/Member → minimum age 45 (only true statement). Covers public servants in and outside India; Chairperson need not be CJI; PM is within its jurisdiction.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who is the first Lokpal of our country?Justice Pinaki Chandra Ghose

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              First Lokpal of India → Justice Pinaki Chandra Ghose (retired SC judge); Lokpal and Lokayukta first proposed by Administrative Reforms Commission (1966-1970).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who among the following has been appointed as the Chairperson of Lokpal of India in 2024?Shri Justice Ajay Manikrao Khanwilkar

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Lokpal Chairperson in 2024 → Justice Ajay Manikrao Khanwilkar (assumed office 10 March 2024); first was Justice Pinaki Chandra Ghose.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Establishment of Lokpal and Lokayukta in India was recommended by –Administrative Reforms Commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Lokpal and Lokayukta → recommended by first Administrative Reforms Commission (set up 5 January 1966 under Morarji Desai; K. Hanumanthaiah from 1967; ended 1970).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Indian Model of Ombudsman is –Lokpal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Indian Ombudsman → Lokpal; Ombudsman began in Sweden (1809). First ARC (Morarji Desai) recommended Lokpal, Lokayukta and a Local Body Ombudsman. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid Ombudsman is a Swedish idea: Sweden, 1809.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The first Lokpal Bill was presented in the Parliament in–1968

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              First Lokpal Bill → 1968 (4th Lok Sabha); passed by Lok Sabha in 1969 but lapsed when Lok Sabha was dissolved.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following statements about the Lokpal Bill, 2011 is/are correct?1, 3 and 4 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Lokpal Bill 2011 → introduced in Lok Sabha 4 August 2011 by V. Narayanaswami (not P. Chidambaram); sent to Standing Committee; civil society called it 'weak'. Law: 1 January 2014.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Civil Society’s representatives in the panel for drafting the Lokpal Bill include:Only 1, 3 and 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Civil society members on Lokpal Bill drafting panel → Anna Hazare, Arvind Kejariwal, Shanti Bhushan, N. Santosh Hegde, Prashant Bhushan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Trap names: 'Prashant Joshi' (real member Prashant Bhushan) and Kiran Bedi, who was not on the panel.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In which of the following States, the office of Lokayukta was, first established?Maharashtra

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              First Lokayukta → Maharashtra (1972); then Bihar (1973), Uttar Pradesh (1975). Odisha passed the first Lokayukta law (body only in 1983) and first abolished it (1993).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The first 'Lokayukta' was established in which of the following States?Maharashtra

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              First Lokayukta → Maharashtra (Act 1971; in effect 25 October 1972). Governor appoints Lokayukta on CM's advice for five years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Odisha passed the first Lokayukta Act, but Maharashtra set up the first Lokayukta.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following States first established the Institution of Lokayukta?Maharashtra

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              First Lokayukta institution → Maharashtra, under the Maharashtra Lokayukta and Upa-Lokayukta Act, 1971.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Lokayukta of Uttar Pradesh submits its report to–Governor

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Uttar Pradesh Lokayukta → submits its report to the Governor (UP Lokayukta Act, 1975); report laid before both Houses of the State Legislature.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • What is tenure of Uttar Pradesh Lokayukta?5 year

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Uttar Pradesh Lokayukta tenure → 5 years or age 70, whichever earlier, from 26 February 2024 (amended Act of 1975); earlier it was 8 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The first Indian State to pass the Lokayukta Bill in 2011 is–Uttarakhand

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              First state to pass the Lokayukta Bill in 2011 → Uttarakhand (1 November 2011).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following are the States where the Chief Minister comes in the ambit of the Lok Ayukta Act?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Chief Minister under Lokayukta Act → Madhya Pradesh and Orissa when asked; now also Himachal Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Punjab and others.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Under Section 7 of the Rajasthan Lokayukta and Deputy Lokayukta Act, 1973, the Lokayukta isempowered to investigate allegations against ministers and public servants in certain cases. Which of the following subject is not part of those investigations?Sexual harassment of women, caste discrimination and violence against children.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Rajasthan Lokayukta Act, 1973 (Section 7) → corruption and misconduct of ministers and public servants. Sexual harassment, caste discrimination, violence against children → police (SC/ST Act, POCSO), not Lokayukta.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A Committee constituted in 2014 under the Chairmanship of Narpat Mal Lodha is related to which of the following subjects?Lokayukta

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Narpat Mal Lodha Committee (2014, Rajasthan) → review of the Lokayukta Act. Lokpal and Lokayukta Act, 2013 came into force 16 January 2014.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Given below are two statements, in which one is Assertion and second is Reason.Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) does not explain (A) correctly.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              'Minority' is not defined in the Constitution (A true); Minority Commission is statutory (National Minority Commission Act, 1992), not constitutional (R true), but R does not explain A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements about the minorities in India:1, 2 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              National Commission for Minorities → statutory (Act of 1992, in force 17 May 1993). Minorities: Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Zoroastrians; Jains added 27 January 2014. Constitution protects religious, linguistic minorities.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements with reference to Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities:Neither 1 nor 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities → Art 350B, added by 7th Amendment, 1956 (not 9th); one officer at Union level appointed by President, not one per State.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The functions of the National Commission for Women are specified in:Section 10 of the National Commission for Women Act, 1990

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Functions of National Commission for Women → Section 10 of the National Commission for Women Act, 1990 (enforced 30 August 1990).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who among the following was appointed as the chairman of Secondary Education Commission by Government of India in 1952?Laxman Swami Mudaliar

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Secondary Education Commission (1952-53) → Chairman Dr. A. Laxman Swami Mudaliar, VC of Madras University; called 'Mudaliar Commission'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following is not in existence now?Planning Commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Not in existence now → Planning Commission (15 March 1950), replaced by NITI Aayog on 1 January 2015. NCW, Minority Commission and NHRC still exist.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Vohra Committee was formed to study-Nexus of Politicians and Criminals

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Vohra Committee (1993) → nexus of criminals, politicians and bureaucrats (criminalisation of politics). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who recommended to end Indian Administrative Services and Indian Police Services?Rajamannar Commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Ending of IAS and IPS (All India Services) → recommended by Rajamannar Commission.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Other than the Fundamental Rights, which of the following parts of the Constitution of India reflect/ reflects the principles and provisions of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (1948)?1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              UDHR (1948) reflected beyond Fundamental Rights in → Preamble (life, liberty: Art 3), Directive Principles (education: Art 26 → Art 45), Fundamental Duties (duties to community: Art 29).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • When was the Universal Declaration of Human Rights adopted by the United Nations?10 December, 1948

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Universal Declaration of Human Rights → adopted by UN General Assembly on 10 December 1948.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • How many Articles are there in ‘Universal Declaration of Human Rights’?30

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Universal Declaration of Human Rights → 30 Articles.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid Think of a month: 30 days, 30 Articles.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 10th December is celebrated as –Human Rights Day

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              10 December → Human Rights Day (UDHR adopted 1948; UN resolution 423(V) in 1950). World Health Day → 7 April; UN Day → 24 October.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The concept of Human Rights primarily emphasizes onDignity of Man as a Human Being

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Concept of Human Rights → mainly emphasises dignity of man as a human being (UDHR Preamble: dignity and justice for all).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following is not considered to be one of the Human Rights listed by the United Nations?Right to Privacy

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              UDHR (10 December 1948) covers freedom and equality, life and liberty, education, and also privacy (no arbitrary interference); the exam key still marked right to privacy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Universal Declaration of Human Rights, adopted by UN General Assembly, doesnot include which of the following?Right to Universal Basic Income

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              UDHR (10 December 1948; 30 Articles; not legally binding) → no right to Universal Basic Income. Includes life, liberty, security (Art 3), adequate standard of living (Art 25).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following is considered to be the second generation of Human Rights?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Second-generation human rights → UDHR Arts 22 to 27, e.g., right to work (Art 23), right to education (Art 26). First generation → Arts 3 to 21.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Eradication of all types of social discrimination comes under which generation of Human Rights?Second generation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Eradication of social discrimination → second-generation human rights. First generation → civil and political (liberty); third → community and collective rights.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse JPSC's key said third generation; the book holds second generation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements:2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              'Right to the City' (Henri Lefebvre, 1968) → not an agreed human right (1 false); inhabitants' right to reclaim public spaces and participate; book marks statements 2 and 3 correct.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Under which Article of the Constitution the Protection of Human Rights Ordinance was issued by the President in 1993?Article 123

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Protection of Human Rights Ordinance, 1993 → issued by President under Article 123 on 28 September 1993, for NHRC, State Commissions and Human Rights Courts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • When did the Protection of Human Rights Act come into force in India?1993

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Protection of Human Rights Act → came into force in India on 28 September 1993.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which statement is true in relation to the Protection of Human Rights Act?The Act came into force on 28th September, 1993.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Protection of Human Rights Act → in force from 28 September 1993; extends to the whole of India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Option traps: 23 September and the year 1995; correct is 28 September 1993.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • What was the objective of the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993?All of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 → set up National and State Human Rights Commissions and Human Rights Courts for better protection of human rights → all of the above.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following rights is not under the purview of the National Human Rights Commission?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NHRC purview (Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993) → rights relating to life, liberty, equality and dignity, guaranteed by Constitution or international covenants and enforceable by Indian courts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In which Section of the Human Rights Protection Act, 1993 is ‘Public Servant’ defined?Section 2(M)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              'Public Servant' in Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 → defined in Section 2(M); same meaning as Section 21 of the Indian Penal Code.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In the definition of armed forces under the Protection of Human Rights Act, which of the following is not included?Armed Forces of the State

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              'Armed forces' under Protection of Human Rights Act → naval, military and air forces and other armed forces of the Union; armed forces of the State not included.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who is not a member of the committee for the appointment of Chairperson and members of the National Human Rights Commission?Chairman of the Council of States

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NHRC selection committee (Section 4, Act 1993) → PM, Lok Sabha Speaker, Union Home Minister, LoPs of both Houses, Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha; Chairman of Rajya Sabha not included.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha is a member; the Chairman of Rajya Sabha is not.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who is not the ex-officio member of the National Human Rights Commission?The Chairperson of the Law Commission of India

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NHRC → statutory body (1993); chairman (retired CJI or SC judge) + four members; 6 ex-officio members; Law Commission Chairperson is not an ex-officio member.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following statement is not correct in relation to Protection of Human Rights Act?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NHRC Chairperson and members (2019 amendment) → term three years or until age 70, whichever earlier; not eligible for further government employment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The tenure of the Chairman of the National Human Rights Commission is3 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NHRC Chairperson → term of 3 years or until age seventy, whichever is earlier.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The term of office of members of the National Human Rights Commission from the date on which he/she enters upon his/her office is—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NHRC Chairman and members → 3 years or until age 70, whichever earlier; afterwards not eligible for Central or State government employment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements regarding the National Human Rights Commission of India –—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NHRC → powers only recommendatory; at least one woman member (civil-society members raised from two to three); Chairman: former CJI or SC judge (2019); SHRCs separate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Read the following and select the correct answer from the code given below:Both (A) and (R) are false.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              NHRC Chairman → former CJI or a Supreme Court Judge (2019 Amendment); term 3 years or age 70 → A ('only former CJI') and R ('5 years') both false. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Among the following who was the first President of Human Rights Commission of India?Justice Rangnath Mishra

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              First NHRC Chairman → Justice Ranganath Misra (12 October 1993 to 24 November 1996); NHRC set up 12 October 1993.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who is the current chairman of the National Human Rights Commission of India?Justice H.L. Dattu

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Justice H.L. Dattu → NHRC Chairman from 29.02.2016 to 02.12.2020; Justice V. Ramasubramanian chairman since 30/12/2024.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who among the following is eligible to be appointed as the Chairperson of Rajasthan State human Rights Commission?Chief Justice of High Court

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              State Human Rights Commission Chairperson → Chief Justice or a Judge of the High Court (Protection of Human Rights (Amendment) Act, 2019).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Chairperson and members of State Human Rights Commission are appointed by –Governor

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              SHRC Chairperson and members → appointed by Governor on recommendation of CM (chair), Assembly Speaker, State Home Minister, LoP in Assembly (+ Council Chairman and LoP if Council exists).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who presides over the committee constituted for the appointment of members of the State Human Rights Commission?The Chief Minister

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              SHRC selection committee (Section 22, Act 1993) → chaired by Chief Minister; Governor is not on it, he only appoints. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)
