                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Panchayati Raj and Community Development: key facts from the book
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Panchayati Raj is a system of democratic decentralisation. Its objective is to bring the development to the grass-root level.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • There are provisions related to Panchayati Raj in Part-IX from Article 243 to Article 243-O in the Indian-Constitution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 16 New Articles in Part-IX and the 11th Schedule wear added in Indian Constitution by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act 1992. Total 29 subjects are mentioned in the 11th Schedule on which, the State legislature may, by law, endow the Panchayats with such powers and authority necessary to enable them to implement schemes for economic development and social justice.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Panchayati Raj is a subject of state list.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The state legislature determines provisions related to the structure of panchayats by law.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The State legislature makes decisions with respect to all matters relating to elections to the Panchayat. The State legislatures makes decision by law. The State Election Commission has superintendence, direction, control of rolls & conduct of elections.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • It is conducted every 5 years.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • There is a provision to form a Finance Commission to review the financial condition of panchayats.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Gram Sabha, is formed by the people registered in the electoral rolls of a village.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Article 40 of the Indian Constitution directs the state to organize village panchayats.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Balwant Rai Mehta committee recommended the establishment of a three-tier Panchayati Raj system at the Village level, Block level and District level.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Balwant Rai Mehta is called the Architect of the Panchayati Raj system.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The inauguration of Panchayati Raj system was done by Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru on 2nd October 1959 at Nagaur (Rajasthan).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Panchayati Raj institutions got constitutional status by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Firstly the Laxmi Mal Singhvi Committee in 1986 and then P.K. Thungan Committee in 1988 recommended Panchayati Raj Institutions be given constitutional status.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Earlier, Ashok Mehta Committee, in 1977 proposed that some provisions of Panchayati Raj can be kept in the Indian Constitution, so the Government of India should think over it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Due to the collapse of the Janta Government, no action could be taken on the recommendations of the Ashok Mehta Committee at the Central Level.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • So, the recommendations of Laxmi Mal Singhvi and P.K. Thungan committee are clearly accepted. Major recommendations of the Balwant Rai Mehta Committee are also accepted in the Part IX of the Constitution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • According to Article 243-D(3) for seats and under Article 243D(4) for Chairperson's office, women are given 1/3rd reservation at all levels of Panchayats.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The minimum age to become a member of the Panchayat is 21 years.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The 74th Constitutional Amendment Act 1992, gives constitutional status to the Urban Local Self-government.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • By this Amendment Act, a new part [Part IX A] and the 12th Schedule were added to the Constitution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • There are 8 types of local self-government which include Municipal Corporation, Municipality, Notified Area Committee, Town Area Committee, Cantonment Board, Township, Major Port Authority/Port Authority (earlier, Port Trust) and Special Purpose Agencies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The 74thAmendmentAct provides three types of municipalities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • This includes Municipal Corporation, Municipal Council and a Nagar Panchayat.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • All the members of the municipality are elected by the people of that area directly. [additional representation may be provided under Article 243R(2)].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The term of the municipality is 5 years, but it can be terminated earlier also.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The State Election Commission has the right to direct, control and manage the elections for the municipalities and Panchayats.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A Finance Commission is constituted under Article 243 I for municipalities and Panchayats.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The Financial Review is specified under Article 243 Y.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A District Planning committee is constituted under Article 243 ZD (1) at the District level to consolidate the plans prepared by the Municipalities and Panchayats in the district and to draft a development plan for the district as a whole.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • According to Article 243ZE, in every metropolitan area, a metropolitan planning committee is to be constituted to prepare a draft development plan for the metropolitan area as a whole.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • In India the first Municipal Corporation was established in Madras in the year 1688.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Lord Ripon is known as the father of local self-government in India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who speaks of India's self-reliant social system 'The rural system in India is a tiny Republic'?Charles Metcalfe

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Sir Charles Metcalfe (acting Governor General), 1830 → called Indian village communities 'little republics', nearly self-sufficient.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who was the Father of local Self-Government in India?Lord Ripon

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Lord Ripon (Viceroy from 1880) → 'Father of local self-government in India'; laid foundations of representative municipal institutions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which Article of the Indian Constitution directs state Government to organize village Panchayats?Article 40

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Art 40 (Directive Principles) → State shall organise village Panchayats and give them powers to work as units of self-government. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Panchayati Raj is organized as a unit of Self Government under –73rd Amendment of the Indian Constitution

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        73rd Amendment (1992) → gave Panchayati Raj constitutional status as a unit of self-government; this third tier was added to the federal system in 1993. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse DPSP only directed States to form Panchayats; constitutional status came from the 73rd Amendment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The legislative origins of the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act can be traced back to which Constitutional Amendment Bill?64th Constitutional Amendment Bill

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        73rd Amendment traces back to the 64th Amendment Bill (prepared 1989, introduced in Lok Sabha July 1989) → first attempt after independence to give Panchayats constitutional status.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • W h i c h C o n s t i t u t i o n a l A m e n d m e n t g r a n t e d Constitutional Status to Panchayati Raj Institutions?73rd Amendment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        73rd Amendment, 1992 → constitutional status to Panchayati Raj; inserted Part IX and the 11th Schedule; in force 24 April 1993. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Constitutional status has been given to Panchayats under Article –243

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Panchayats → Part IX, Arts 243 to 243-O, added by 73rd Amendment Act 1992; 11th Schedule lists 29 subjects for Panchayats.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        73rd Amendment (1992, in force 24 April 1993) → watershed: Part IX gave Panchayats constitutional status; 73rd and 74th Amendments came under PM P.V. Narsimha Rao. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which Article gives the list of 29 functions to be performed by the Panchayati Raj Institutions?Article 243(G)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Art 243G → powers, authority and responsibilities of Panchayats (the 29 functions); State Legislature, by law, devolves them so Panchayats work as self-government units.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 73rd Amendment of the Constitution has provided for:All the four

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        73rd Amendment → regular Panchayat elections (Art 243K), at least one-third seats for women (243D), funds via State Finance Commission (243I), 29 subjects of 11th Schedule. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following is not a part of the Eleventh Schedule of the Constitution?Rural Sports

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        11th Schedule (73rd Amendment Act, 1992) → 29 matters for Panchayats; Rural Sports is NOT one (libraries, fuel and fodder, technical training are).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • In context to Constitution of India which statement is correct?Article 243(C) – Composition of Panchayat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Art 243A → Gram Sabha; 243B → Constitution of Panchayats; 243C → Composition of Panchayats. (243(a), (b), (c) only define District, Gram Sabha, Intermediate level.)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse Don't mix 243A (Gram Sabha's powers) with 243(b), which only defines 'Gram Sabha'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who among the following is authorized to make provisions with respect to the composition of Panchayats?Legislature of State

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Art 243-C(1) → State Legislature makes law on the composition of Panchayats (not Governor, Parliament or President).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which of the following is not correct with respect to the composition of Panchayat?Each State will constitute Panchayat at the village, intermediate and district level.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Not correct: 'every State must have all three levels'. Art 243B(2): intermediate Panchayat may be skipped where State population is not over 20 lakh.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What is the system of governance in the Panchayati Raj set up?The three-tier structure of local self-government at the village, block and district levels.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Panchayati Raj → three-tier: village, block (intermediate), district; intermediate tier optional in a State with population not exceeding twenty lakh [Art 243B(2)].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What is the system of governance in the Panchayat Raj set-up?Three tier structure of local self government at the village, block and district levels

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Art 243B → three-tier Panchayati Raj: village, intermediate (block), district; no intermediate tier needed in a State with population up to 20 lakh (2 million).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What is the minimum population below, which at the intermediate level the Panchayats are not constituted as per provisions of the Indian Constitution (73rd Amendment Act)?20 Lakh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        73rd Amendment (Part IX, Arts 243-243O; gives shape to Art 40) → three tiers; intermediate Panchayat not needed in States with population not exceeding 20 lakh.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid Small State (20 lakh or less) can skip the middle tier — a sandwich without the filling.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Under Article “243J” which of the following can make provisions to the maintenance of accounts by Panchayats?State Legislature

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Art 243J → State Legislature, by law, provides for maintenance of Panchayat accounts and their audit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid 243J → 'J' for 'Jaanch' (जाँच, checking) of accounts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • With reference to Panchayats which of the statements is/are correct?3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Only 3 correct: Panchayats at village, intermediate, district levels [Art 243B(1)]. Gram Sabha = persons on village electoral rolls, not all residents; no 'fifty percent SC/ST women' rule.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Article 243(J) of the Indian Constitution is related to.Audit of Accounts of Panchayats

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Art 243-J → maintenance and audit of Panchayat accounts by State law; part of 73rd Amendment Act, 1992 (Part IX, Arts 243-243O).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The tenure of every Panchayat in India is five years from–The scheduled date of its first meeting

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Art 243E → Panchayat term: five years from the date fixed for its first meeting; if dissolved early, fresh election within six months.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • With reference to Panchayati Raj Institutions in India which of the following statements is / are correct?Only 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Panchayat tenure 5 years [Art 243E(1)] — true. Not 1/4: not less than one-third of SC/ST reserved seats go to SC/ST women [Art 243D].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Election was held on 20 January, 2014 for a Gram Panchayat. Its first meeting was called on 10 February 2014. Thereafter Gram Panchayat was dissolved on 20th February, 2016. Election was held on 15th May, 2016 for New Gram Panchayat and, its first meeting was called on 25th May, 2016. What shall be tenure of the new constituted Gram Panchayat?10th February, 2019

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A Panchayat formed after early dissolution serves only the rest of the old term: old term began 10 February 2014, so new one ends 10 February 2019.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse Term runs from the first meeting (10 February 2014), not from election day or the new body's meeting.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • If a Panchayat is dissolved, elections are to be held within–six months

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Dissolved Panchayat → election before 6 months from dissolution (Art 243E); normal term five years from first meeting. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What is not correct about Gram Panchayat?ii iii vi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Chhattisgarh Panchayati Raj Act, 1993 → Gram Panchayat: 10 to 20 wards, one Panch each, plus Sarpanch; all elected, none nominated (ii, iii, vi wrong).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following functions is not the concern of Local Self Government?Maintenance of Public Order

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Maintenance of public order is NOT a local self-government function; public health, sanitation, public utilities, roads are (Art 243G Panchayats, Art 243W Municipalities).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which is not among the powers of Panchayati Raj Institutions in India?Judicial Review

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Judicial review is not a Panchayati Raj power — it belongs to the judiciary (Supreme Court); land reforms and poverty alleviation programmes are PRI tasks.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Nyaya Panchayats in Panchayati Raj System have no powers ofawarding imprisonment except in the State of-—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Bihar Panchayati Raj Acts 1947 and 1993 let Nyaya Panchayats imprison; Patna High Court struck that part down (1996); Bihar's 2006 Act allows no imprisonment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Consider the following statements -1 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Statement 1 true: Part IX (Panchayats) inserted by 73rd Amendment Act, 1992 (in force 24 April 1993). Statement 2 false: Art 243-Q does not envisage only two municipality types. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The decision to conduct Panchayat Elections is taken by which of the following?The State Government

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Panchayat is entry 5 of the State List (7th Schedule) → State Government decides on Panchayat elections, held through the State Election Commission.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • According to Constitutional Provisions the decision to hold Panchayat elections is taken by -State Government

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Decision to hold Panchayat elections → State Government (Art 243K); Panchayati Raj is a State List subject. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Don't confuse Don't pick the State Election Commission or the Election Commission of India: the decision rests with the State Government.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The elections to Panchayats are to be held after –Every five years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Panchayat elections every five years: Art 243-E(1) → term five years from first meeting; 243-E(3) → after dissolution, election within six months.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which one of the following is not concerned with the Panchayats?The Constitution (74th Amendment) Act.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        74th Amendment relates to Municipalities, not Panchayats; Panchayats (73rd) → State Election Commission polls, fixed five-year term, fresh election within six months of dissolution.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory aid 73 comes before 74 → village (Panchayat) before town (Municipality).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The first State to Implement 73rd Constitutional Amendment is-Madhya Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Madhya Pradesh → first State to implement the 73rd Amendment (Act of 1992, in force 24 April 1993) in true spirit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • National Panchayati Raj Day in India is celebrated on24 April

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        National Panchayati Raj Day → 24 April every year; first celebrated in 2010.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Where was the National Panchayati Raj Day 2025 event organised?Madhubani

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        National Panchayati Raj Day 2025 main event → 24 April 2025, Lohna Uttar Gram Panchayat, Madhubani (Bihar); 32nd anniversary of 73rd Amendment (in force 24 April 1993).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • In the new Panchayati Raj Bill enacted in 1992, there are several new provisions different from the previous one. Which one of the following is not one such provision?Regular remuneration to the panchayat members, so as to ensure their punctuality and accountability.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        73rd Amendment (1992 Bill) did NOT give regular pay to Panchayat members; it did give mandatory elections, one-third seats for women, duties like agriculture and rural development.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)
