                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Read the key facts and each question with its answer (30 min), then cover the answers and recall (10 min). Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Assertion (A): Reservation in the Office of Pradhans, P r a m u kh s a n d A d h y a ks h a s i n Panchayats for women including SCs, STs and OBCs has brought about a distinct change in their working.A is true but (R) is false.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A true, R false: women's reservation as Pradhan, Pramukh, Adhyaksha changed their working; it was not a long-standing demand. Art 243-D: not less than one-third seats for women. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • With reference to the reservation of seats for women in Panchayati Raj Institutions, which of the following statements is/are correct?1 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Women's reservation in Panchayats → Art 243D(3): not less than one-third of directly elected seats, by rotation; it is not tied to the Art 334 expiry period.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following was not proposed by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment in context to Panchayati Raj?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              73rd Amendment: women get one-third (not 30%) of seats; no two-child disqualification. It did provide State Finance Commissions and elections within six months of dissolution. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The reservation of seats for women in Panchayats has been provided by an amendment to Constitution of India. That amendment is –73rd amendment of 1992

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              73rd Amendment, 1992 → Art 243-D(3): not less than one-third of directly elected Panchayat seats reserved for women.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In India, seats are reserved for women in –Panchayati Raj Institutions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Women's reservation: Panchayati Raj bodies (Art 243-D, one-third); later 106th Amendment, 2023 (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam) → one-third in Lok Sabha, State Assemblies, Delhi Assembly. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following Articles provides reservation of seats for the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in the Panchayats?243D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Art 243D → reservation of seats for SCs and STs in Panchayats; 243A Gram Sabha, 243B constitution, 243C composition of Panchayats.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid 243 A-B-C-D: gram sAbha, Building (constitution), Composition, D for 'Dalit/tribal reserveD seats'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which State Governments have provided 50 percent reservation for women in local bodies up to 2010?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Up to 2010 (asked in 2011), 50% women's reservation in Panchayats: Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh; now many more States (e.g. Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Rajasthan, Uttarakhand).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The number of seats reserved for women in Panchayati Raj Institutions in U.P. is –One-third of total seats

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Uttar Pradesh Panchayat Laws (Amendment) Act, 1994 (in force 22 April 1994) → one-third of Panchayat seats reserved for women in U.P.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Reservation of seats in Panchayat elections for Scheduled Castes shall not apply to the State of –Arunachal Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              SC seat reservation in Panchayat elections does not apply to Arunachal Pradesh — no SC population there (Census 2011).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • When was the Panchayats (Extension to the Scheduled Areas) Act passed by Indian Parliament?1996

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              PESA (Panchayats Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act → passed 1996 on Bhuria Committee recommendations; applies to Fifth Schedule areas in ten States. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Government enacted the Panchayat Extension to Scheduled Areas (PESA) Act in 1996. Which one of the following is not identified as its objective?To create autonomous regions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              PESA Act 1996 aims → self-governance, recognise tribal traditional rights, free tribals from exploitation; NOT autonomous regions. Not in force in Assam, Meghalaya, Tamil Nadu.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In the areas covered under the Panchayat (Extension to the Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996, what is the role/ power of Gram Sabha?Only 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Under PESA 1996, Gram Sabha owns minor forest produce and can stop land transfer; its consent is needed for minor-mineral leases only, not other minerals.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Gram Sabha's say covers minor minerals only — so statement 3 ('any mineral') is false.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • What is correct about the powers of Zila Panchayats of Scheduled Areas?All of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Chhattisgarh Panchayat Raj Act, 1993 → Zila Panchayats in Scheduled Areas plan minor water bodies, control social-sector institutions and tribal sub-plans, do State-assigned functions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ‘Gram Sabha’ means –Persons registered in electoral rolls related to a Panchayat area at the village level

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Gram Sabha → persons registered in the electoral rolls of a village-level Panchayat area; foundation of Panchayati Raj.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Not all residents and not Panchayat members — only registered voters.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following statements is not true regarding ‘Gram Sabha’?Its powers are determined by the Central Government.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Gram Sabha [Art 243(b)] → permanent village assembly of registered voters; its powers come from State Legislature law, NOT the Central Government.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • What is correct:(i) (ii) (v)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A Gram Panchayat can cover more than one village; Gram Sabha meets in each village (by rotation); Gram Panchayat meets at its headquarters.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • What is not correct about Gram Sabha?v vi vii

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Chhattisgarh Act 1993 (amended 2004): Gram Sabha meets every three months; quorum 1/10 of members, one-third women; Sarpanch and Panchs ensure quorum; adjourned meeting needs no quorum.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who will preside the meeting of the Gram Sabha in absence of the sarpanch and up-sarpanch in Madhya Pradesh?For this purpose the Panch of the respective Gram Panchayat, elected by the members, present in the Gram Sabha Meeting

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Madhya Pradesh (Panchayati Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, 1993) → if Sarpanch and Up-Sarpanch are absent, a Panch elected by members present chairs the Gram Sabha.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which section of the Rajasthan Panchyati Raj Act, 1994 has been amended to replace the expression 'Gram Vikas Adhikari' in place of 'Gram Sevak'?89

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Rajasthan Panchayati Raj Act, 1994 → Section 89 amended: term 'Gram Vikas Adhikari' put in place of 'Gram Sevak'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who presides over the meeting of Gram Sabha in Scheduled Areas?Schedule Tribe member present who is elected by Gram Sabha

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              PESA rules → Gram Sabha meeting in Scheduled Areas is chaired by a Scheduled Tribe member chosen by consensus for one year; failing consensus, the oldest ST woman present.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 refers to the –Laying the foundation of strong and vibrant Panchayati Raj Institutions in the Country.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              73rd Amendment Act, 1992 → foundation of strong, vibrant Panchayati Raj Institutions; the 74th Amendment Act deals with Municipalities.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 73rdAmendment of the Constitution was implemented on 24 April, 1993. This amendment will encourage in Rajasthan-Self-Governance system

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              73rd Amendment (implemented 24 April 1993) → aims at a local self-governance system under Panchayati Raj.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following is related to the theme of ‘Grass Root Democracy’?Panchayati Raj System

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              'Grass-root democracy' → Panchayati Raj (decentralisation of power); Nehru inaugurated Panchayati Raj in Rajasthan on 2 October 1959.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Panchayati Raj System is a System of-1,2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Panchayati Raj → local self-governance, three-tier governance with bio-relations, and 'Democratic Decentralisation' (Balwant Rai Mehta's term); not hierarchy construction.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The fundamental object of Panchayati Raj system is to ensure which among the following?1 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Basic aim of Panchayati Raj → people's participation in development + democratic decentralisation; began 2 October 1959, Nagaur (Rajasthan); constitutional status by 73rd Amendment, 1992. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following is not an attribute of a Local Government?Central control

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Local government attributes → statutory status, local community participation, power to tax; NOT central control (its aim is decentralisation).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Panchayati Raj is mainly aimed at –Decentralization of power to villagers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Panchayati Raj's main aim → democratic decentralisation of power to villagers, so they make and carry out policies for their own needs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • What is the main characteristic of Panchayati Raj System of Government?All of these are true.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Panchayati Raj → three tiers (Gram Panchayat-village, Panchayat Samiti-block, Zila Parishad-district); aims at economic development and social justice; MPs sit in Zila Parishad.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following statements regarding Panchayati Raj is not correct?73rd Amendment came into effect on 15th August, 1993.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Wrong: '73rd Amendment came into effect on 15 August 1993' — correct date is 24 April 1993. Art 243-G (Panchayat powers) adds to its importance. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • For successful functioning, Panchayati Raj needs full co-operation of-Local Public

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Panchayati Raj needs full cooperation of the local public; its goals fail without their support and participation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Panchayati Raj in India represents –All of these

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Panchayati Raj represents decentralisation of democratic power, community development and people's participation — all of these.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements: In the post-73rd Amendment era, there has to be decentralization of:1, 2 and 4 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Post-73rd Amendment (in force 24 April 1993) decentralisation → decision-making powers, the system as a whole, administrative powers; not judicial powers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following is not the characteristic of decentralization?To instill non-confidence among local communities

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Decentralisation → autonomy, people's participation, empowering local communities; instilling non-confidence is NOT its feature. It extends delegation to the lowest level.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements -Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              73rd Amendment rejuvenated rural local bodies and reduced political interference in rural matters (A and R true, R explains A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • State Government has no authority over local bodies in relation to which one of the following matters?Citizen’s Complaints

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              State Government has no authority over local bodies on citizens' complaints; it does control them in economic matters, law-making and service matters.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The nomenclature of rural local governments as 'Panchayati Raj' was the result of the suggestion of which Indian leader?M. K. Gandhi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Name 'Panchayati Raj' for rural local governments → suggested by Mahatma Gandhi; he wanted each village a self-sufficient 'little republic'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Name the Committee which was set up by the NDC in 1957 for the reorganization of CDP and NES, which suggested a three-tier system of rural local government-Balwant Rai Mehta Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (set up by NDC, 1957) → reviewed CDP (1952) and NES (1953); recommended three-tier Panchayati Raj; Rajasthan first to adopt it. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid Balwant = 'bal' (strength) of three tiers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 10 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following committees recommended ‘Three-Tier Panchayt Raj System’?Balwant Rai Mehta Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Balwant Rai G Mehta Committee (appointed January 1957, report November 1957) → three-tier Panchayati Raj, 'Democratic decentralisation'; reviewed CDP (1952), NES (1953).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer from the code given below the lists:2 1 4 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Balwant Rai Mehta (1957) → three-tier; Ashok Mehta (1977, report 1978) → two-tier; G.V.K. Rao (1985) → better representative character; L.M. Singhvi → local self-government system. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid Balwant 3 tiers, Ashok 2 tiers: the later Mehta cut one tier.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • According to democratic decentralization recommended by Balwant Rai Mehta committee?Three-tier democratic Panchayati Raj institutions were to be set up at the village, block and district levels.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) → democratic decentralisation through three-tier Panchayati Raj at village, block and district levels.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)
