                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Panchayati Raj and Community Development · part 3 of 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    33 facts · 51 questions · 9 Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Read the key facts and each question with its answer (30 min), then cover the answers and recall (10 min). Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following is not a level in the three-tier Panchayati Raj recommended by Balwant Rai Mehta Committee?Nyaya Panchayat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Balwant Rai Mehta tiers (report November 1957) → Village Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti (block), Zila Panchayat; Nyaya Panchayat is not a tier.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Nyaya Panchayat as a separate body came from the Ashok Mehta Committee (1977-78), not Balwant Rai Mehta.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The Panchayati Raj System was first started in India in the State of Rajasthan and ..................Andhra Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Panchayati Raj first started in Rajasthan (Nagaur, 2 October 1959, by Nehru), then in Andhra Pradesh (second State). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid R before A: Rajasthan first, Andhra second; Nagaur opened on Gandhi Jayanti.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 17 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following committees is not concerned with Panchayati Raj Institution?P.V.N. Rao Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Not a PRI committee: P.V.N. Rao. PRI committees: Balwant Rai Mehta 1957 → Ashok Mehta 1977 → C.H. Hanumantha Rao 1983 → G.V.K. Rao 1985 → L.M. Singhvi 1986. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid Order B-A-H-G-S: 'Big Ashok Has Good Sense'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 8 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following Committee is not associated with Panchayati Raj System?V.K.R.V. Rao Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    V.K.R.V. Rao Committee is NOT a Panchayati Raj committee — V.K.R.V. Rao was an economist (UN Commission for Economic Development, National Income Committee).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse V.K.R.V. Rao (economist) with G.V.K. Rao (Panchayati Raj committee).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following Committees is not associated with Panchayat Raj System in India?Dinesh Goswami Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Dinesh Goswami Committee (1990) → Electoral Reforms, not Panchayati Raj; L.M. Singhvi, Sadiq Ali, Ashok Mehta committees relate to Panchayati Raj.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which model was recommended by Ashok Mehta Committee for Panchayati Raj System?Two-tier

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Ashok Mehta Committee (1977, report August 1978) → two-tier Panchayati Raj: Zila Parishad (district) and Mandal Panchayat (village group, 15000 to 20000 people). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • With reference to the recommendations of the Ashok Mehta Committee (1977) on Panchayati Raj, which of the following statement/s is/are correct?Only (1)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Ashok Mehta Committee (1977) → replace three-tier with two-tier (not implemented); district, not block, as first point of decentralisation below the State.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following Committees/Commissions recommended the creation of Nyaya Panchayats?Ashok Mehta Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Ashok Mehta Committee (report 1978) → recommended Nyaya Panchayats and a two-tier Panchayati Raj system.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following Committees recommended to give Constitutional status to Panchayati Raj?L.M. Singhvi Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    L.M. Singhvi Committee (1986) → constitutional recognition and protection for local self-government; no political parties in Panchayat elections. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid Singhvi = Samvidhan: both start with S — constitutional status.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following is not correctly matched?G.V.K. Rao Committee – Planning at the Block Level

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Not matched: G.V.K. Rao Committee (1985) → administrative arrangements for rural development and poverty alleviation, not 'Planning at Block Level'. Dantwala → Rural Credit; Santhanam → PRI finances.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following pairs is/are correctly matched? (A) Rationalisation of Panchayat — V.R. Rao Statistics(A), (C) and (D)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    V.R. Rao → Rationalisation of Panchayat Statistics; S.D. Mishra → Working Group on Panchayats and Co-operatives; G.V.K. Rao → Administrative Arrangements for Rural Development and Poverty Alleviation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which part of our Constitution envisages a three-tier system of Panchayats?Part IX

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Part IX (Art 243-B) → three-tier Panchayats: village, intermediate, district; intermediate tier optional in States with population not over twenty lakh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The Three-tier system of Panchayati Raj consists of-Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti, Zila Parishad

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Three tiers of Panchayati Raj → Gram Panchayat (village), Panchayat Samiti / Block Panchayat (block), Zila Parishad (district).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following was constituted under the Panchayati Raj system?Gram Panchayat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Gram Panchayat is formed under Panchayati Raj (not Khap, Caste or Jan Panchayats); wards elect Panchs directly; Sarpanch elected as per the State Act.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Consider the following statements: I. Panchayats at the intermediate level exist in all States. II. To be eligible to be a Member of a Panchayat at the intermediate level, a person should attain the age of thirty years. III. The Chief Minister of a State constitutes a commission to review the financial position of Panchayats at the intermediate levels and to make recommendations regarding the distribution of net proceeds of taxes and duties, leviable by the State, between the State and Panchayats at the intermediate level. Which of the statements given above are not correct?I, II and III

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    All three false: intermediate Panchayat optional below 20 lakh population (Art 243B); minimum age 21, not 30; Governor, not Chief Minister, sets up the Finance Commission.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following have been covered by 73rd Amendment of the Constitution?Only 1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    73rd Amendment → Gram, Kshetra and Zila Panchayat; Nagar Panchayat, Nagar Palika Parishad and Nagar Nigam come under the 74th Amendment Act, 1992. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Nagar Panchayat sounds rural but is an urban body — it falls under the 74th Amendment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Territory of a Kshetra Panchayat (Panchayat at intermediate level) is determined by –State Government

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Territory of a Kshetra Panchayat (and all Panchayats) → fixed by the State Government; Art 243-C(2): seats filled by direct election from territorial constituencies.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Who notify the alteration in limits of Block and Zila Panchayat?Governor

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Chhattisgarh Panchayat Raj Act, 1993, Section 127 → Governor, by notification, alters limits or headquarters of a Block (and Zila Panchayat).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Match list-I and List-II and give correct answer using code given below:A-2, B-1, C-4, D-3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Status 1999: Zila Parishad at sub-divisional level → Assam; Mandal Praja Parishad → Andhra Pradesh; Janajati Parishad → Meghalaya; no Gram Panchayats → Mizoram.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following States does not have any Panchayati Raj Institution?Nagaland

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    No Panchayati Raj Institutions in Mizoram, Nagaland and Meghalaya (per the book); Assam, Kerala, Tripura have them. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid 'M-N-M' trio without Panchayats: Mizoram, Nagaland, Meghalaya.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which State does not have Panchayat system?None of the above/More than one of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Art 243M(2) → Part IX (Panchayats) does not apply to hill areas of Nagaland, Meghalaya, Mizoram and Manipur where district councils exist — so 'more than one'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Match the List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists:3 4 2 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Intermediate Panchayat names: Janpad Panchayat → Madhya Pradesh; Kshetra Panchayat → Uttar Pradesh; Taluka Parishad → Gujarat; Anchalik Parishad → West Bengal.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The Members of Panchayat Samiti are -Directly elected by the public

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Jharkhand Panchayati Raj Act, 2001, Section 32 → Panchayat Samiti; its members are directly elected by the public.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The members of the Panchayat Samiti are –Directly elected by the people.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Panchayat Samiti → intermediate (block) level; members directly elected by the people; called Kshetra Panchayat in Uttar Pradesh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following was established as the first programme of community development?National Extension Service

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    First community development programme (book answer) → National Extension Service; CDP (1952) had three phases: National Extension, Intensive Community Development Project, Post Intensive Development. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • At what level does a Panchayat Samiti operate a Panchayati Raj structure?Block-level body

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Panchayat Samiti → block-level (intermediate) body; Gram Panchayat at village and Zilla Panchayat at district (73rd Amendment Act, 1992).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A Panchayat Samiti at the block level is –An administrative authority

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Panchayat Samiti (block level) → an administrative authority; link between Gram Panchayats and Zila Panchayat; processes village plans for funding and implementation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A Panchayat Samiti at the block level in India is only a/anAdministrative Authority

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Panchayat Samiti → administrative authority (coordination and execution); Zila Parishad → supervisory and coordinating body.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Don't swap: 'supervisory and coordinating' describes Zila Parishad, not Panchayat Samiti.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Chairman of a Zila Panchayat in Uttar Pradesh is elected:2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    U.P. Kshetra Panchayats and Zila Panchayat Act, 1961, Section 19 → Zila Panchayat Chairman elected by elected members from among themselves; Section 19-A → SC/ST/OBC reservation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • If the President of Zilla Panchayat is suspended, what will happen?The members will elect President temporarily

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Chhattisgarh Panchayat Raj Act, 1993, Section 39(3) → if Zila Panchayat President is suspended, a special meeting within fifteen days; members elect a temporary President.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following are the Standing Committees of Zila Panchayat in Madhya Pradesh?1, 2 and 3 are correct

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Madhya Pradesh Zila Panchayat standing committees → General Administration, Agriculture, Education, Communication and Works, Co-operation and Industries (five).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • What is not legal?A woman Sarpanch can nominate her husband to participate in the meeting of Gram Panchayat and Janpad Panchayat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Not legal: a woman Sarpanch cannot send her husband to Gram or Janpad Panchayat meetings; ex-officio MLAs and MPs (Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha) may nominate representatives.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The 73rd Amendment of Indian Constitution provides –making panchayat elections mandatory and equivalent to the polls of Lok Sabha and Legislative Assembly

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    73rd Amendment → Panchayat elections made mandatory, held by a State Election Commission (Art 243-K), to make them as fair as Lok Sabha and Vidhan Sabha polls.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)
