Open the chapter in the full notes for explanations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following is not true about local governance in India?There is no separate category of local governance in the federal system of Indian Constitution.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          False: 'no separate category of local governance'. The Constitution provides for local governance in Art 40, Part IX and Part IX-A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following functions of State Election Commission and select the correct answer using the code given below?(1) and (2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          State Election Commission [Arts 243-K(1), 243-ZA(1)] → prepares electoral rolls and conducts all elections to Panchayats and Municipalities.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In which Article provision for superintendence, direc tion and control to the conduct of all elections to the Municipalities in Chhattisgarh?Article 243 Z A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Art 243ZA → State Election Commission (of Art 243K) controls electoral rolls and all elections to Municipalities.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse 243K = Panchayat elections; 243ZA = Municipal elections — the same State Election Commission handles both.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • All elections to the Panchayats are conducted by-State Election Commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          All Panchayat elections → State Election Commission (Art 243K); Municipal elections also SEC (Art 243ZA); State Election Commissioner appointed by the Governor. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For election to the Panchayat, the State Election Commissioner will be appointed byGovernor of the State

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          State Election Commissioner (Panchayat elections, Art 243K) → appointed by the Governor of the State. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following statements regarding State Election Commission, Rajasthan -Only (ii) is correct

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Rajasthan State Election Commission → constituted July 1994 (not December); one-member body; its secretary is also the State's Chief Electoral Officer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following statements regarding State Election Commission, Rajasthan:Both (i) and (ii) are correct.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Rajasthan State Election Commission → set up July 1994 under Art 243K; single-member, headed by State Election Commissioner; holds PRI and municipal elections.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Madhya Pradesh State Election Commission was constituted on1 February, 1994

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Madhya Pradesh State Election Commission → constituted 1 February 1994 (under Arts 243-K and 243-ZA).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • State Chief Election Commissioner is appointed by—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          State Election Commissioner → appointed by the Governor (Art 243K); question deleted because it said 'State Chief Election Commissioner'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • If a candidate expired before polling in Panchayat election, then what shall be happened?iii, iv

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Chhattisgarh Panchayat Nirvachan Niyam, 1995, Section 46 → candidate dies before polling: poll postponed only if one candidate is left; not postponed if more remain.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • What is correct about Panchayat election?i ii iii iv v vi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Chhattisgarh Panchayat polls → one District Election Officer; one or more Returning Officers, appointed by SEC (or DEO with its consent); Naib Tehsildar can be RO for Janpad/Gram Panchayat.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which statement is correct about Panchyati Raj?Election of the Panchayati Raj Institutions is conducted under the supervision of the State Elections Commission.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Panchayati Raj elections are held under the State Election Commission; Zila Parishad is not wholly directly elected (ex-officio MPs, MLAs, Samiti heads); contest age is not 18.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A person can contest the Panchayat election, if he has attained the age of –21 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Art 243-F(1) → minimum age to be a Panchayat member: 21 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse Voting age is 18, but contesting a Panchayat seat needs 21.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The minimum age for contesting elections to the Panchayati Raj Institutions should be how many years according to the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act?21 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          73rd Amendment → minimum age to contest Panchayati Raj elections: 21 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following statements:2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Panchayat member minimum age → 21 (not 25); Panchayat reconstituted after early dissolution serves only the remainder of the term (Art 243E).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A college student desires to get elected to the Municipal Council of his city. The validity of his nomination would depend on the important condition, among others, thatHis name figures in the voter’s list.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          To contest a Municipal Council election, one's name must be in that municipality's electoral roll; party membership or college permission is not needed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Who among the following constitutes “Finance Commission” to review the financial position of Panchayats?The Governor of the concerned State

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Art 243(I) → Governor constitutes a Finance Commission within one year of the 73rd Amendment Act, 1992 and every fifth year after, to review Panchayat finances.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Who is empowered to review financial position of the Panchayats?Finance Commission constituted by the Governor

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Panchayat finances → reviewed by a State Finance Commission constituted by the Governor under Art 243-I (Part IX); it recommends to the Governor.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • To review the financial position of Panchayats, the State Government constitutes every five years a/anfinance commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Every five years, a Finance Commission (Art 243I, set up by the Governor) reviews Panchayat finances — a commission, not a committee.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Who amongst the following is responsible for revenue distribution between the State Government and the Local Governments?State Finance Commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          State Finance Commission (Art 243I, set up by the Governor) → recommends how revenue is shared between the State Government and local governments.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Under which Article of the Indian Constitution the State Finance Commission is established –Article 243(I)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Art 243(I) → State Finance Commission, to review finances of Panchayati Raj Institutions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Memory aid 243 I-J-K: I = Income (Finance Commission), J = Jaanch (audit), K = Kaun jeetega (elections).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following authorities recommends to the Governor about the principles of determination of taxes and fees which may be appropriated by the Panchayats of that state?State Finance Commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          State Finance Commission (Art 243I) → recommends to the Governor principles for taxes, duties, tolls and fees assigned to or taken by Panchayats.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following statements and select the correct answer using the code given below:(A) is false, but (R) is true.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A false, R true: Union Finance Commission (Art 280) does recommend measures to boost State funds for Panchayats and Municipalities; local government stays a State subject.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Study the following statements and select the correct answer from the code given below:(A) is true, but (R) is false.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          State Election Commission → constitutional body (73rd and 74th Amendments, 1992); it, not the Election Commission of India, conducts all local body elections.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following are Constitutional Authorities? Select the correct answer using code given below:1,2 and 3 Only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Constitutional authorities: State Election Commission (Art 243K), State Finance Commission (243I), District Panchayat (243B); State/Chief Electoral Officer is not. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following parts of the Constitution is related to Municipalities?Part IX A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Part IX-A → Municipalities; added by the 74th Amendment Act, 1992; in force from 1st June 1993.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following statements regarding the 74th Amendment to the Constitution of India are correct?1, 2 and 3 are correct

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          74th Amendment Act, 1992 (in force 1 June 1993) → Part IX-A (Arts 243P-243ZG), new 12th Schedule with 18 items, women's seats in Municipalities; not limited to some States.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following Constitutional Amendment Acts accorded Constitutional Status to the Municipalities?The Constitution (74 Amendment) Act, 1992 th

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          74th Amendment, 1992 → constitutional status to Municipalities (urban local bodies): Part IX-A (Arts 243P-243ZG) and the 12th Schedule. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Memory aid 73 = gaon (village), 74 = shahar (town): one number up, one step up to the town.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • With reference to Municipalities, which of the following statements is/are correct?Only 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Municipality member: minimum age 21, not 25 (Art 243V); not less than one-third of directly elected municipal seats reserved for women (Art 243T(3)).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The provision of reservation of seats for scheduled tribes in Municipalties in Madhya Pradesh has been made under which of the following Articles of the constitution of India?243 T (1)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Art 243T(1) → reservation of seats for Scheduled Tribes in Municipalities (asked for Madhya Pradesh).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Memory aid 243T → 'T for Tribes' (seat reservation in Municipalities).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • What is the amount of security deposit to contest the election of a Mayor by a candidate belonging to the general category?Rs. 30,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Rajasthan Mayor election security deposit → Rs. 30,000 for general candidates; Rs. 15,000 for women, SC, ST and Backward Class candidates.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The tenure of a Mayor is of -5 year

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Mayor's tenure → 5 years, as Municipal Corporation's term is 5 years (Art 243U); exceptions: Delhi and Bengaluru one year, Mumbai 2.5 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following criteria for deciding an urban area, according to Census of India, is not correct? All places with:At least 60% of the male population engaged in non agricultural pursuits.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Census urban area: population at least 5000, at least 75% (not 60%) of working men in non-farm work, density at least 400 per sq km.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse The trap is 60%; the Census rule is 75% of male workers in non-agricultural work.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In the following questions, there are two statements. One is labelled as Assertion (A) and other is labelled as Reason (R):Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is correct explanation of Assertion (A)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Art 243Q → Municipal Corporation for a larger urban area; big cities get corporations because their administration is very complex (A and R true, R explains A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Ifthere is dispute between Panchayat and Cantonment Board, who will decide finally?State Government, subject to approval of Central Government

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Chhattisgarh Municipalities Act, 1961, Section 79(2) → Panchayat vs Cantonment Board disputes decided by the State Government with Central Government's concurrence.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Who among the following is the competent authority to notify the territorial region of a municipality in State?Governor of the State concerned

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Art 243P(d) → Municipal area = territorial area of a Municipality as notified by the Governor.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • According to the provisions of the Rajasthan Municipal Act, 2009, maximum number of persons that can be nominated by the state government in Municipal council is -8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Rajasthan Municipal Act, 2009 → State Government may nominate up to 6 in a municipal board, 8 in a municipal council, 12 in a municipal corporation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Memory aid 6-8-12: nominations grow with size — board, council, corporation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A person shall not be disqualified for being chosen as a member of a municipalityAt the age of 21 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Art 243V → minimum age for Municipality membership is 21 years; a 21-year-old cannot be disqualified on the ground of age.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • What is the qualification to contest the election of Municipal Council?i ii v

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Chhattisgarh Municipalities Act, 1961, Section 34 → a voter on the municipal roll may contest: President at 25+, Councillor at 21+; cannot contest from two wards at once.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • What is correct about the tenure of municipal council?ii iii iv

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Municipal council term → 5 years from the date of its first meeting (not result day); after dissolution, election within six months.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • What is correct about the recall of President of Municipal Council?ii iv vi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Chhattisgarh Municipalities Act, 1961, Section 47 → President recalled by secret ballot of more than half of voters voting; proposal signed by 3/4 elected councillors.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • What is correct about the wards committee of Nagar Panchayat?i, ii, iii

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Art 243S → ward committees (population three lakh or more); elected ward councillors are members; Chhattisgarh adds two nominated ward residents; chairman not nominated by Nagar Panchayat President.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • If a Councillor as a legal practitioner acts on befalf of any other person against the Municipal Council, What will be happened?Collector will remove him from the office

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Chhattisgarh: a Councillor who acts as legal practitioner for another person against the Municipal Council is removed from office by the Collector.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The chairman of a Municipality in U.P. is elected:2 and 4 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          U.P. Municipality chairman → elected directly by voters on the area's electoral list, including electors of wards (statements 2 and 4).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which one of the following pairs is not correctly matched?Ghaziabad Nagarpalika Parishad

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Ghaziabad → Nagar Nigam (Municipal Corporation), not Nagarpalika Parishad; Kanpur Nagar Nigam; Lucknow Cantonment Board; Kakori Nagar Panchayat (Lucknow).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 73rd and 74th Amendments of the Constitution are responsible for the creation of which of the following?1,2 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          73rd/74th Amendments created: State Election Commission (243-K, 243-ZA), State Finance Commission (243-I, 243-Y), District Planning Committee (243-ZD); not State Property Tax Valuation Board.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Constitution (Seventy-Third Amendment)Act, 1992, which aims at promoting the Panchayati Raj Institutions in the country, provides for which of the following?2 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          73rd Amendment → State Election Commissions for Panchayat polls (243K) and State Finance Commissions (243-I); District Planning Committees come from the 74th (Art 243ZD).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse District Planning Committee (243ZD) is in Part IX-A — 74th Amendment, not 73rd.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • How many elected and Ex-Officio members are there in District Planning Committee?20 and 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Rajasthan District Planning Committee → 20 elected and 5 ex-officio members (varies by State: Bihar 34 members, Chhattisgarh 20).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the District Planning Committee constituted?Article 243 ZD

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Art 243ZD → District Planning Committee: consolidates plans of Panchayats and Municipalities and prepares a draft development plan for the district.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Memory aid ZD = 'Zila Development' plan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Who becomes the chairperson of district Planning Committee in Rajasthan?Zila Pramukh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Rajasthan: Zila Pramukh chairs the District Planning Committee (Section 121, Rajasthan Panchayati Raj Act, 1994; DPC under Art 243ZD).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which among the following Panchayats, are included in the District Plan in U.P.? I. Nagar Panchayat II. Gram Panchayat III. Kshetra Panchayat Select the correct answer using code given below:I, II and III

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          District Plan in U.P. covers Nagar Panchayat, Gram Panchayat and Kshetra (Block) Panchayat; Planning Commission's first district-planning guidelines came in 1969.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following has been provided in the 74th Amendment Act, 1992 of the Constitution?(ii), (iii) and (iv)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          74th Amendment Act, 1992 → Ward Committees (population 3 lakh or more), Metropolitan Planning Committee (Art 243ZE), District Planning Committee (Art 243ZD); 'Municipal Committees' not among them.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Consider the following statements: In India, a Metropolitan Planning Committee –1 and 2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Metropolitan Planning Committee (Art 243-ZE) → constitutional body; prepares draft development plan for the metropolitan area and sends it to the State Government; does not implement schemes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Who among the following are eligible to benefit from the ‘Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act’?Adult members of any household

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          MGNREGA → adult members of any household get at least 100 days' work; Act 2005, in force 2 February 2006, renamed 2 October 2009; started in Anantpur (Andhra Pradesh).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Which of the following bears the responsibility of planning, execution and implementation of MNREGA schemes?Gram Panchayat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          MGNREGA → Gram Panchayat plans (after Gram Sabha's recommendation), executes and implements works; new VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 got President's assent on 20 December 2025.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Don't confuse Gram Sabha only recommends; the Gram Panchayat is responsible for execution.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)
