                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Special Provisions Relating to Certain Classes: key facts from the book
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The special provisions relating to certain classes are contained in Part XVI of the Constitution from Articles 330 to 342 A.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Part XVI also includes Articles 330A, 332A and 334A inserted by the Constitution (One Hundred and Sixth Amendment) Act, 2023.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Article 330 provides for the reservation of seats for SCs and STs in the House of the People.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Under Article 331, provision was made for the representation of the Anglo-Indian community in the House of the people. It is noteworthy that the arrangements of nominating representatives of the Anglo Indian Community in the House of the People have also not been extended beyond the stipulated date (25 January, 2020) by 'the Constitution (One Hundred and Fourth Amendment) Act, 2019.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Article 332 provides for the reservation of seats for SCs and STs in the legislative assemblies of the States.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Under Article 333, provision was made for the representation of the Anglo-Indian Community in the Legislative Assemblies of the States. It is noteworthy that the arrangements of nominating representatives of the Anglo-Indian Community in the Legislative Assemblies of the states have also not been extended beyond the stipulated date (25 January, 2020) by 'the Constitution (One Hundred and Fourth Amendment) Act, 2019.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Article 338 provides for provisions relating to the National Commission for SCs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • At present, Kishor Makwana is the chairman of this commission.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Article 338A was added by the 89th Constitutional Amendment Act 2003, which provides for a separate National Commission for STs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The President can appoint a commission to investigate the conditions of Socially and educationally backward classes (Article 340).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The President can declare any caste, race, tribe, part or groups of a State/U.T. as a Scheduled Caste after consulting with the Governor of that State. (Article 341(1)).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The President can declare any caste of a state/UT as a Scheduled Tribe after consulting with the Governor of that State [Article 342(1)]. Note: The Constitution (One Hundred and Fourth Amendment) Act, 2019 provides for extending the period of reservation of seats for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes for the next 10 years, whereas the provision for nomination of Anglo-Indian members has not been made beyond the predetermined date (25 January, 2020). So, currently this arrangement has ended. Newly added Articles in Part XVI (added by the 106th Constitution Amendment Act, 2023) have provisions as mentioned below.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Article 300 A: As nearly as may be, one-third (including the number of seats reserved for women belonging to the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes) of the total number of seats to be filled by direct election to the House of the People shall be reserved for women.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Article 332 A: As nearly as may be, one-third of the total number of seats to be filled by direct election to the Legislative Assembly of every State shall be reserved for women (including the number of seats reserved for women of SC and ST categories).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Article 334 A: When the Reservation of Seats for Women takes effect: The reservation, of one-third of the total seats to be filled by direct election, for women shall take effect after a delimitation is undertaken for the figures of the first Census taken after the commencement of the 106th Constitution Amendment Act, 2023.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                This reservation shall cease to have effect, on the expiration of a period of fifteen years from such commencement.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Part XVI (from Art. 330 to 342) of the Indian Constitution deals with –Reservation of seats for SC/ST and representation of Anglo-Indian Community in the House of people.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Part XVI (Arts 330-342A) → special provisions for certain classes: Art 330 SC/ST seats in Lok Sabha; Art 331 Anglo-Indian representation in Lok Sabha.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Under Indian Constitution, Provision for Scheduled Tribes in Lok Sabha has been made under –Article 330

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Art 330 → SC/ST seat reservation in Lok Sabha; Art 332 → same in State Legislative Assemblies.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In which Article of the Indian Constitution is there a provision of reservation of seats for Scheduled Trigbes in the State Assembly?Article 332

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Art 332 → SC/ST seat reservation in State Legislative Assemblies, in proportion to their share of the State's population.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse Art 243D is SC/ST reservation in Panchayats, not State Assemblies.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Authority to specify as to which castes shall be deemed to be Scheduled Castes rests with the–President

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Art 341 → President (after consulting the Governor, for a State) notifies which castes are Scheduled Castes in a State/UT. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Under which Article of the Indian Constitution does the President issue a public notification for the Scheduled Tribes for a specific state?Article 342

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Art 342 → President, after consulting the Governor, notifies Scheduled Tribes for a State/UT; Parliament can add or remove tribes by law.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which statement is not correct?The lists of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes are prepared and amended by the concerned State Governments.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Not correct: 'States prepare and amend SC/ST lists'. Parliament includes or excludes by law (Art 341 SCs, Art 342 STs); first lists by President's order, 1950.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements:2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                President (not Governor) notifies Scheduled Tribes under Art 342(1), State-wise after consulting the Governor; a tribe ST in one State need not be ST in another.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which community was categorized as Scheduled Caste (SC) by a 2015 Bihar government notification which was quashed in july 2024 by the Supreme Court, ruling that states cannot make changes to the SC list published under Article 341 of the Constitution?Tanti-Tantwa

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Tanti-Tantwa → put in SC list by Bihar's 2015 notification; Supreme Court quashed it in July 2024: States cannot change the SC list under Art 341.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Scheduled Tribe status is –Religiously neutral.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Scheduled Tribe status is religiously neutral (ST Order, 1950); SC status (SC Order, 1950, para 3) only for Hindus, incl. Buddhists and Sikhs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The specifications required for a community to be declared as a Scheduled Tribe are:All of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ST criteria (not in the Constitution, but well established) → primitive traits, distinctive culture, geographical isolation, shyness of contact with the community at large, backwardness.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • After the Amendment in Indian Constitution by the Parliament on 14 August, 2007 the number of castes in the list of Scheduled Caste is –1206

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                After the 2007 amendment → 1206 Scheduled Castes; after the SC Amendment Act, 2017 → 1261; SCs are 16.6% of population (Census 2011).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • State having maximum Scheduled Tribes is -Madhya Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Most Scheduled Tribe population (among options) → Madhya Pradesh; order: Madhya Pradesh > Rajasthan > Andhra Pradesh > Bihar.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In which of following there is no reservation for any caste?Rajya Sabha; State Legislative Council

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                No caste reservation in Rajya Sabha or State Legislative Councils; SC/ST seats only in Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies (book accepts a & c).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Provision of National Commission for Scheduled Tribes is given in which Article of the Constitution?Article 338A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Art 338A → National Commission for Scheduled Tribes; Art 338 → National Commission for Scheduled Castes; split by the 89th Amendment Act, 2003. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Under which Article of the Constitution of India, has the National Commission for Scheduled Castes been constituted?Article 338

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Art 338 → National Commission for Scheduled Castes; originally a Special Officer for SCs/STs; 65th Amendment Act, 1990 made it a multi-member National Commission.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Under which Article of the Constitution the Separate Scheduled Tribe Commission was established?338-A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Separate National Commission for STs → Art 338-A, inserted (and Art 338 amended) by the 89th Amendment Act, 2003.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The total number of members other than the Chairperson and Vice-Chairperson of the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes is:3 Members

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                National Commission for Scheduled Tribes → Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson and three full-time members (one a woman).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following is/are constitutional body/ bodies?Only (ii)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Only NCST is a constitutional body (Art 338A, 89th Amendment Act, 2003; set up 19 February 2004); NHRC, NIA and NDMA are not.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • What s the position of representation of Anglo-Indian Community in Lok Sabha?Nomination of them has been done away with by 104th Constitutional Amendment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Anglo-Indian nomination to Lok Sabha (Art 331: President could nominate two) → done away with by the 104th Amendment.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 • Which of the following article is related to the representation of Anglo-Indian community in the legislative assemblies of the states?Article – 333

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Art 333 → Anglo-Indian representation in State Legislative Assemblies; 104th Amendment Act, 2019 ended Anglo-Indian seats in Lok Sabha and Assemblies.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which Amendment to the Constitution abolished the two seats that were reserved for the Anglo-Indian community?104th

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                104th Amendment Act, 2019 (enacted 2020) → abolished the two Anglo-Indian seats in Lok Sabha and Assemblies; extended SC/ST reservation for another 10 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • U.N.O. was founded in -1945

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      UNO founded 1945: Charter drafted at San Francisco (April-June 1945), signed by 50 nations on 26 June 1945; Poland 51st; UN Day 24 October.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The number of permanent members in the United Nations Security Council is:5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      UN Security Council → 15 members: 5 permanent (USA, France, China, UK, Russia) + 10 non-permanent elected for 2 years; Germany is not permanent.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      April 2024 UNSC vote on Palestine's full UN membership: USA vetoed; Switzerland and UK abstained → 3 members rejected or abstained.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Only the 5 permanent UNSC members (USA, France, China, Britain, Russia) have veto power — not any member.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Larry Pressler → US Senator; Pressler Amendment (1986) linked US aid to nuclear non-proliferation; criticised Clinton administration's military help to Pakistan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Match the following:4 1 2 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Pressler Amendments → US aid linked to nuclear capacity; Chakma refugees → Bangladesh; Perestroika → Gorbachev; 13 September 1993 → Israel-PLO agreement.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ‘Pivot to Asia’ is the strategy of the foreign policy ofU.S.A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      'Pivot to Asia' → foreign-policy strategy of the U.S.A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • C.I.A. is the intelligence agency of –U.S.A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      C.I.A. (Central Intelligence Agency) → civilian foreign intelligence service of the U.S.A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Research and Analysis Wing (RAW) is part of which of the following?Cabinet Secretariat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Research and Analysis Wing (RAW) → India's foreign intelligence agency; set up 21 September 1968 under PM Indira Gandhi; works under the Cabinet Secretariat.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Don't confuse RAW is under the Cabinet Secretariat — not the Home Ministry, PMO or External Affairs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • What is “Mossad”?Israel’s intelligence agency

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Mossad → national intelligence agency of Israel (intelligence collection, covert operations, counter-terrorism).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • What does ISI stand for?Inter-Services Intelligence

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ISI = Inter-Services Intelligence → Pakistan's premier military-run intelligence agency.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Memory aid Spy agencies: CIA-USA, RAW-India, Mossad-Israel, ISI-Pakistan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • What is Fourth Estate?Press

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      'Fourth Estate' of democracy → the Press, for its role in nation-building.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which of the following is the Centre of British News Papers –Fleet Street

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Fleet Street (Central London) → historic centre of British newspapers (till 1980); last major office, Reuters, left in 2005.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Consider the following statements –1 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Russian Parliament → Federal Assembly; Lower House = State Duma; Upper House = Council of the Federation (statements 2 and 3 swap them).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The Parliament of Japan is known as –Diet

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Parliaments: Japan → Diet (Imperial Diet); Sweden → Riksdag; Spain → Cortez; Poland → Sejim.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Chinese Parliament is known as –National People’s Congress

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      China's Parliament → National People's Congress (NPC): 2977 members, world's biggest; in practice a rubber stamp for the Communist Party.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The political leadership of which country is known as ‘Princeling’?China

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      'Princelings' → descendants of senior Communist officials in China (the Party's 'crown princes').

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Tass is the news agency of –Russia

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      TASS → official news agency of the Soviet Union till 1991; renamed ITAR-TASS (Russia) from 1992.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • What is the name of China’s News Agency?New China News Agency

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      China's news agency → New China News Agency.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ‘Dawn’ is a newspaper of which of the following countries?Pakistan

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Dawn → leading English newspaper of Pakistan; founded by Mohammad Ali Jinnah in Delhi on 26 October 1941.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Government Report of which of the following countries is known as ‘Yellow Book’?France

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      'Yellow Book' → government report of France.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Consider the following statements –1 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Commonwealth → has no charter, treaty or constitution; ex-British territories did not join automatically, a country must declare it (Burma, Egypt, Kuwait, UAE never joined).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • 'It is an agreement by free will to be terminated by free will.' The above statement of Pt. Nehru refers to which of the following?India's Association with the Commonwealth of Nations

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Nehru on India's Commonwealth membership → 'an agreement by free will, to be terminated by free will'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The first Indian Prime Minister who visitedAfghanistan was –Jawaharlal Nehru

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      First Indian PM to visit Afghanistan → Jawaharlal Nehru (September 1959); then Indira Gandhi (1976); Narendra Modi visited on June 4, 2016.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The Indian Foreign Policy of Non-Alignment was initiated by –Jawaharlal Nehru

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Non-Alignment policy → started by Jawaharlal Nehru as interim PM: stay away from international power blocs and keep an independent foreign policy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following is not a principle of“Panch sheel”?Non-alignment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Panchsheel's five principles: respect for territorial integrity and sovereignty, non-aggression, non-interference, mutual benefit and equality, peaceful co-existence; Non-alignment is NOT one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Who was the Prime Minister of India when the basic principle of India's Nuclear Doctrine of 'No First Use' was adopted?Atal Bihari Vajpayee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      India's 'No First Use' nuclear doctrine → stated after the 1998 tests, formally adopted January 2003, under PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The Six Points Formula proposal of India for South Asian Region was presented by which Prime Minister of India?Atal Bihari Vajpayee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Six Points Formula for the South Asian region → presented by PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which country has recently reaffirmed Arunachal Pradesh as an integral part of India?USA

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      USA reaffirmed Arunachal Pradesh as an integral part of India (July 2023; again March 2024, rejecting China's claim).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Minimum age for M.P. (Lower house) M.P. (Upper house) and President is25, 30 and 35

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Minimum age: Lok Sabha member 25 [Art 84(b)], Rajya Sabha member 30, President 35 [Art 58(1)(b)].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Memory aid 25-30-35: add five at each step — Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, President.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer from the code given below the lists:2 3 4 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Minimum ages: 21 → Panchayat member; 25 → State Legislative Assembly member; 30 → State Legislative Council member; 35 → President of India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below:3 4 2 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Oaths: President → faith and allegiance to the Constitution; SC Judges → upholding Constitution and law; MPs → faithful discharge of duties; Union Ministers → secrecy of information.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Meaning of Extra-Constitutional Right -That power which is not in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Extra-constitutional power → one not found in the Constitution's provisions; e.g., Planning Commission, made by a Cabinet resolution, yet it wielded power over Centre and States. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Consider the following events:3 – 2 – 1 – 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Chronology: Air India nationalised (1953) → Imperial Bank renamed State Bank of India (July 1955) → first elected communist government, EMS Namboodiripad (April 1957) → Goa joins India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The powers of District Collector as a District Magistrate are: A. To maintain law and order B. Control over police C. To check passports of foreigners D. To control land revenue Select the correct answer using the code given below: Code:A, B, C

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      District Collector as District Magistrate → law and order, control over police, passport/visa and foreigners' matters; land revenue is his role as Collector.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Don't confuse Land revenue comes under the 'Collector' hat, not the 'District Magistrate' hat.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Who among following has called the District Collector an ‘Institutional Charisma’?Rajni Kothari

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Rajni Kothari (book 'Politics in India') → called the District Collector an 'Institutional Charisma'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Which one of the following statements is not correct?Madam Cama was the first woman President of Indian National Congress,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Wrong: Madam Cama was not the first woman INC President — Annie Besant was (32nd session, 1917, Kolkata); Cama hoisted India's flag at Stuttgart, 22 August 1907.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)
