                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Consider the following statements:Only 1 and 2 are correct.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            True: right to life and personal liberty can't be suspended in Emergency; Vice-President removed by Rajya Sabha resolution approved by Lok Sabha. NITI Aayog replaced Planning Commission, January 1, 2015.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which one of the following statements is not correct?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Two wrong: 8th Schedule has 22 languages (not 18) since the 92nd Amendment, 2003; Queen Victoria's Proclamation (November 1, 1858), not Charter Act 1813, is the 'Magna Carta'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which among the following is/are correct: High Courts hold their office till the age of 62 years.1,2,3 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            All true: HC judges serve till 62 [Art 217(1)]; national party needs recognition in 4+ States; Lok Sabha Speaker decides Money Bills [Art 110(3)]; cognizable offence → arrest without warrant.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • What is that crime, which when tried is punishable, but when done the culprit crime doer cannot be punished?Suicide

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Suicide → a crime whose doer cannot be punished; only the attempt was punishable (IPC Section 309); Law Commission's 210th report urged deleting Section 309.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • What is true about gallantry award 'Param Vir Chakra'?On its medal, four replicas of 'Indra Vajra' are embossed

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Param Vir Chakra → highest military decoration; instituted 26 January 1950; four 'Indra Vajra' replicas on the medal; can be won more than once; 21 awardees till 31 December 2025.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Don't confuse Instituted 1950, not 1952 (option trap).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Consider the following statements in respect of Bharat Ratna and Padma Awards:1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            All three false: Bharat Ratna/Padma Awards aren't titles under Art 18(1); Padma Awards (1954) interrupted twice (1978-1979 and from 1993); Bharat Ratna not capped at five a year.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Who among the following is the recipient of Bharat Ratna for 2024?M. S. Swaminathan

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Bharat Ratna 2024 (announced February 9, 2024, posthumous) → P.V. Narasimha Rao, Chaudhary Charan Singh and M.S. Swaminathan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Who was among following to receive first Bharat Ratna?S. Radhakrishnan

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            First Bharat Ratna (1954) → C. Rajagopalachari, Dr. S. Radhakrishnan and C.V. Raman; of the options, S. Radhakrishnan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Who among the following was the first Indian to be awarded the ‘Bharat Ratna’?C. Rajagopalachari

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Bharat Ratna instituted 1954; first awardees C. Rajagopalachari, S. Radhakrishnan, C.V. Raman. Non-Indians: Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan (1987, first), Nelson Mandela (1990).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • At present, the highest Civilian award of the 'Republic of India' is–Bharat Ratna

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Highest civilian award of India → Bharat Ratna; Bharat Ratna and Padma Vibhushan were both instituted in 1954.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Who amongst the following are members of the Jury to select the recipient of 'Gandhi Peace Prize'? I. The President of India II. The Prime Minister of India III. The Chief Justice of India IV. The Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha Select the correct answer using the code given below.II, III and IV

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Gandhi Peace Prize (instituted 1995, Gandhi's 125th birth anniversary) jury → PM (chair), Chief Justice of India, Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha — not the President.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which institution in India has been selected for Gandhi Peace Award 2021?Geeta press, Gorakhpur

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Gandhi Peace Prize 2021 → Gita Press, Gorakhpur; prize instituted 1995 on Gandhi's 125th birth anniversary; open to all regardless of nationality.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Match the following lists:iv iii ii i

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Outstanding Parliamentarian Award (from 1995): Murli Manohar Joshi 2009, Arun Jaitley 2010, Karan Singh 2011, Sharad Yadav 2012.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Memory aid Initials J, J, K, S run in alphabet order with the years 2009 to 2012.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which among the following States has record of formation of maximum Coalition Governments between 1967 to1971?Bihar

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Bihar → record nine coalition governments between 1967 and 1971.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Who among the following is the first Indian transgender Judge?Joyita Mondal, West Bengal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Joyita Mondal (West Bengal) → India's first transgender Judge, of a Lok Adalat at Islampur (North Dinajpur), at age 29.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Press Council of India is a –Statutory Quasi-judicial Body

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Press Council of India → statutory quasi-judicial body, set up 1966 under the Press Council Act, 1965.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Who is the Chairman of the Press Council of India?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Justice Markandey Katju → Press Council chairman from October 5, 2011. Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai's first term ended December 2025; she was reappointed for three years the following April.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which of the following is a reason of emergence of regionalism in India?All the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Regionalism in India arises from uneven development, fear of losing cultural identity and desire for political prominence — all of these.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The National Water Development Agency was established in the year –1982

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            National Water Development Agency → set up July 1982 as an autonomous society (Societies Registration Act, 1860); National Water Board formed September 1990.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which is the correct chronological order of the following?4, 2, 1, 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Chronology: Tashkent Agreement (10 January 1966) → Indo-Soviet Treaty (August 9, 1971) → Shimla Agreement (2 July 1972) → Farakka Accord (1977; final 1996).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Memory aid T-I-S-F: 'This Is Simply Fine'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Bangladesh was created as a result of Indo-Pak hostilities in -December, 1971

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Bangladesh created December 1971: India intervened on 3 December 1971; Pakistani Army surrendered on 16 December 1971.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Who is the founder of terrorist group Lashkar-e-Taiba?Hafiz Muhammad Saeed

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Lashkar-e-Taiba → founded 1990 in Kunar Province (Afghanistan) by Hafiz Muhammad Saeed, Zafar Iqbal and Mahmoud Mohammad Bahaziq.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which of the following countries have banned LTTE?India, Sri Lanka, U.S.A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            LTTE banned by India, Sri Lanka, USA and many others; its chief Prabhakaran was killed in the Sri Lankan Army's 2009 operation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 'Djibouti' Code of Conduct is related to:International Maritime grouping against piracy

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Djibouti Code of Conduct (adopted 29 January 2009) → against piracy and armed robbery on ships in the Western Indian Ocean and Gulf of Aden.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Match the following - A. Operation Checkmate 1. Maldives4 1 2 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Operation Checkmate → Sri Lanka; Operation Cactus → Maldives; Operation Blue Star → Punjab; Operation Siddharth → Bihar.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • “Bahujan Hitaya, Bahujan Sukhaya” is the motto of:All India Radio

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            'Bahujan Hitaya, Bahujan Sukhaya' → motto of All India Radio.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which one of the following pairs is not correctly matched?Silent Valley Aandolan - Baba Aamte

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Wrong pair: Silent Valley movement → Dr. Salim Ali, not Baba Aamte (Narmada Bachao, wildlife); Apico → P. Hegde; Chipco → S.L. Bahuguna; Narmada Bachao → Medha Patkar.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • To whom the Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) is military advisor on Tri-services matters?Defence Minister of India

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Chief of Defence Staff → military advisor to the Defence Minister on tri-service matters; first CDS General Bipin Rawat (1 January 2020); now General Anil Chauhan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • What is not true in reference to Chief of Defence Staff?He is Chairman of Defence Acquisition Council

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Not true: CDS chairs Defence Acquisition Council — the Defence Minister does. CDS: age limit 65, permanent Chairman of Chiefs of Staff Committee, member of Defence Planning Committee (NSA chairs).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • What are the duties of the Chief of Defence Staff(CDS) as Head of the Department of Military Affairs?1 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            CDS (Head, Department of Military Affairs) → permanent Chairman of Chiefs of Staff Committee and principal military advisor to Defence Minister; does NOT command the three Service Chiefs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which of the following is not correctly matched?Armoured Corps Centre and School- Jabalpur

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Wrong pair: Armoured Corps Centre and School is at Ahmednagar (Maharashtra), not Jabalpur; Southern Air Command Thiruvananthapuram, Eastern Naval Command Visakhapatnam, Army Medical Centre Lucknow.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The number of operational commands of the Indian Army is (as of June 1999) -6

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Army operational commands: 5 in June 1999, 6 now — Western (Chandi Mandir), Eastern (Kolkata), Northern (Udhampur), Southern (Pune), Central (Lucknow), South Western (Jaipur, from 2005).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which of the following is/are correctly matched in terms of equivalent rank in the three services of Indian Defence forces?3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Equal ranks: Army Major = Air Force Squadron Leader = Navy Lieutenant Commander (only pair 3 is right; pairs 1, 2, 4 are wrong).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Don't confuse Brigadier's Navy equal is Commodore, not Commander; Lieutenant Colonel's is Commander.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • In Indian Navy, the equivalent of an army lieutenant colonel is:Commander

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Army Lieutenant Colonel = Navy Commander = Air Force Wing Commander; Colonel = Captain = Group Captain; Brigadier = Commodore = Air Commodore.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Memory aid Navy names sit one step 'up': Army Colonel → Navy Captain, Lt Colonel → Commander.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 1 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Operations undertaken by the Army towards upliftment of the local population in remote areas to include addressing of their basic needs is called:Operation Sadbhavana

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Operation Sadbhavana → Army's work for upliftment of local people in remote areas (basic needs); idea: human security is key to national security.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Border guards: BSF → Pakistan and Bangladesh; ITBP → China; SSB → Nepal and Bhutan; Assam Rifles → China and Myanmar.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            BHARATPOL → online portal for international police cooperation, developed by the CBI; launched 7 January 2025 by Home Minister Amit Shah.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Castes are being politicised (emerging as pressure groups) and casteism is rising in politics — both true, but R does not explain A.

Jaishankar, Minister of External Affairs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Revise: The Constitutional Development of India to Schedules

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  38 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Cover each line, recall it, then check. Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In which of the following Acts, the provision was made for the establishment of Supreme Court at Calcutta?Regulating Act, 1773

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Regulating Act 1773 → Supreme Court at Fort William, Calcutta; set up in 1774; first Chief Justice Sir Elijah Impey. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • By which one of the following Acts was the Federal Court in India created?None of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Federal Court → created by Government of India Act 1935; started 1st October 1937; first Chief Justice Sir Maurice Gwyer. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse Options list only 1861, 1909, 1919 Acts, so the answer is 'None of the above'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Under which of the following Acts, Dyarchy was introduced at Central level?Government of India Act, 1935

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Dyarchy at the Centre → Government of India Act 1935 (never implemented); it abolished the provincial dyarchy of the 1919 Act. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse 1919 Act = dyarchy in provinces; 1935 Act = dyarchy at Centre.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Indian Legislature was made bicameral for the first time byThe Government of India Act of 1919

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Government of India Act 1919 → central legislature bicameral for the first time: Council of State (upper, 60 members) and Legislative Assembly (lower). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which among the following introduced the Provincial Autonomy in British India?Government of India Act 1935

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Government of India Act 1935 → provincial autonomy, All India Federation (federal polity) and dyarchy at the Centre; the 1919 Act had only begun provincial autonomy. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Indian Constituent Assembly was established under –Cabinet Mission, 1946

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Constituent Assembly was set up under the Cabinet Mission Plan, 1946, by indirect election. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Who of the following was not the member of the Interim National Government formed in August 1946 A.D.?Dr. S. Radhakrishnan

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Interim Government (announced 24 August 1946): Rajagopalachari – Education, Rajendra Prasad – Food and Agriculture, Jagjivan Ram – Labour; S. Radhakrishnan not a member. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Member of constituent assembly, who drafted the Constitution of India, were-Elected by legislative assemblies of various provinces

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Constituent Assembly members → elected by provincial legislative assemblies, roughly one seat per million people; 292 from provinces, 4 from Chief Commissioners' provinces. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Who was the first elected Chairman of Constituent Assembly?Dr. Rajendra Prasad

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  First meeting (9 December 1946) chaired by Dr. Sachchidanand Sinha (temporary); Dr. Rajendra Prasad elected permanent Chairman 11 December 1946, proposed by J.B. Kripalani. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse Temporary chairman (Sinha) with first elected chairman (Prasad).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Statement I: The first meeting of the Constituent. Assembly was held on 9th December, 1946 in New Delhi.Statement I is true, but Statement II is false.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  First meeting → 9 December 1946, Constitution Hall (now Central Hall), New Delhi; Nehru was a member from day one and moved Objective Resolution 13 December 1946; President: Rajendra Prasad. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Constituent Assembly of India was established on:09 December, 1946

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Constituent Assembly first met (was established) 9 December 1946; first session ran to 23 December 1946 with 207 members; Nehru moved Objective Resolution in fifth meeting. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Who proposed the Preamble before the Drafting Committee of the Constitution?Jawaharlal Nehru

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Preamble's basis before the Drafting Committee → Nehru's Objectives Resolution (13 December 1946; passed 22 January 1947). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • How many Sessions of the Indian Constituent Assembly were conducted for the formulation of Indian Constitution?12

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  11 sessions (165 days) up to adoption, 26 November 1949, plus a final sitting 24 January 1950 for signatures → 12 sessions; time taken 2 years 11 months 18 days. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Who was the Constitutional Advisor at the time of the formation of the Constitution?B.N. Rau

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Constitutional Advisor of the Constituent Assembly → Sir Benegal Narsing Rau (B.N. Rau). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Constitution of India was completed on:November 26, 1949

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Constitution adopted, enacted and completed → 26 November 1949 (date in Preamble); citizenship, interim Parliament and transitional provisions came into force that day. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Indian Constitution was adopted by –Constituent Assembly

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Constitution adopted and enacted by the Constituent Assembly (11th session) on 26 November 1949, as stated in the Preamble itself. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Who was the Chairman of the Provincial Constitution Committee of the Constituent Assembly?Sardar Patel

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Provincial Constitution Committee → Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel; Drafting Committee → Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly under Dr. B. R. Ambedkar had how many other members?6

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Drafting Committee: Ambedkar + 6 members: N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar, Alladi Krishnaswamy Ayyar, K.M. Munshi, Mohd. Saadullah, B.L. Mitter, D.P. Khaitan (later N. Madhava Rao, T.T. Krishnamachari). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • K.M. Munshi was related to:Constitution Draft Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  K.M. Munshi → member of the Drafting Committee (formed 29 August 1947 under Ambedkar); Jawaharlal Nehru was not a member. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In Indian political system which one is supreme?The Constitution

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The Constitution is supreme in India's political system: the supreme law that frames all government institutions, rights, directives and duties. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The system of judicial review exists inIndia and U.S.A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  System of judicial review exists in both India and the USA. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The feature of Federal system of the Indian Constitution is inspired by the constitution of:Canada

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Indian federal system (federalism) → inspired by the Constitution of Canada. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Concurrent List included in Indian Constitution is given by-Australia

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Concurrent List → borrowed from Australia; in Seventh Schedule; originally 47 items, now 52. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The concept of the Directive Principles of State Policy in the Indian Constitution was borrowed from the Constitution of:Ireland

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  DPSP (Part IV, Arts 36-51) → from the Irish Constitution; not justiciable, but the State must apply them in making laws. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid Ireland → Instructions to the State: both start with I.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The concept of Fundamental Rights, as incorporated in the Indian Constitution has been adopted from-United States of America
