                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Lok Sabha Secretariat comes under the direct control of the:Speaker of the Lok Sabha

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Lok Sabha Secretariat → under direct control of the Speaker; authority exercised through the Secretary (Art 98; rules 124 and 124-A). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Don't confuse Not under Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs or PM; Parliament's secretariats are independent of the executive.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which of the following are correct about the Rajya Sabha?1 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Rajya Sabha: never dissolved; one-third members retire every second year; member's term 6 years (not five); minimum age 30 (not 25). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which of the following statements is correct regarding the Rajya Sabha?One-third of its members retire every two years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Rajya Sabha → permanent House, cannot be dissolved (Art 83(1)); one-third members retire every two years; each member elected for six years. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Memory aid Six-two-third: six-year term; every two years, one-third retire.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which one of the following statements about Rajya Sabha is correct?It is not subject to dissolution.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Rajya Sabha → not subject to dissolution; members elected by elected MLAs (Art 80(4)); Vice-President is ex-officio Chairman; Attorney General can speak in both Houses. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Don't confuse Rajya Sabha does not choose its Chairman from its members; it elects only the Deputy Chairman.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The number of members nominated by the President in Rajya Sabha is–12

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            President nominates 12 members to Rajya Sabha (Art 80), from Literature, Science, Art and Social Services. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Memory aid 12 nominees from 'LSAS': Literature, Science, Art, Social service.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which one of the following statements is not correct regarding the power of the Parliament to legislate on a matter in the State List?Only the Rajya Sabha can make laws with respect to a matter in the State list in the national interest.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Art 249 → Rajya Sabha resolution (two-thirds present and voting) lets Parliament, not Rajya Sabha alone, legislate on a State List subject in national interest; for whole or part of India. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Consider the following statements:1 and 2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Rajya Sabha: cannot reject/amend Money Bill, only recommend within 14 days, which Lok Sabha may reject (Art 109); cannot vote on Demands for Grants; can discuss Annual Financial Statement. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which among the following States has the lowest number of elected members in the Rajya Sabha?Himachal Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Fewest elected Rajya Sabha members among options → Himachal Pradesh (3); Jammu and Kashmir 4 (now UT), Chhattisgarh 5, Jharkhand 6. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • In which House is the presiding officer not a member of that House?Rajya-Sabha

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            House presided over by a non-member → Rajya Sabha (Chairman = Vice-President, elected by members of both Houses). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which of the following are/is stated in the Constitution of India?Both 1 and 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Art 59(1) → President is not a member of either House; Art 79 → Parliament = President + two Houses; both are written in the Constitution. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Presidentis a part of the Parliament

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            President → integral part of Parliament (Parliament = President + Council of States + House of the People), though not a member and does not sit in it. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 12 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Minimum how many times the Parliament has to meet in a year:Twice

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Parliament must meet at least twice a year; gap between two sessions cannot exceed six months (Art 85(1)). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Officers of the Parliament include –All the four

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Officers of Parliament → Lok Sabha Speaker, Deputy Speaker, Secretary-General of Lok Sabha and Chairman of Rajya Sabha. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A seat of a M.P. can be declared vacant if he absents himself from the house for a continuous period ofTwo months

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            MP absent without permission from all meetings for sixty days (two months) → House may declare his seat vacant (Art 101(4)). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Who will decide the Office of Profit?President and Governor; Union Parliament

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Office of profit: declared by law by Parliament (Art 102(1)(a)) or State Legislature (Art 191(1)(a)); disqualification decided by President/Governor on Election Commission's advice (Arts 103, 192). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Parliament of India has the 'Power to Legislate' for the following–1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Parliament can legislate for the Union of India, the Territory of India, and Indian subjects and their property anywhere in the world. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Union Parliament may legislate on any subject of State List –All of above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Parliament may legislate on State List: to implement international agreements (Art 253); by consent of two or more States (Art 252); Rajya Sabha 2/3 resolution (Art 249); during Emergency. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Memory aid 249-252-253 = Rajya resolution, States' request, Treaties.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Parliament can make law for the whole or any part of India for implementing International Treaties –Without the consent of any state

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Art 253 → Parliament can make law for whole or any part of India to implement international treaties/agreements, even on State List, without any State's consent. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Time of zero-hour in Parliament is:11 am to 12 noon; 12 noon to 1.00 pm

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Zero Hour (Indian innovation): Lok Sabha 12 noon-1 pm, after Question Hour (11-12); Rajya Sabha 11 am-12 noon; maximum one hour. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Who presides over the joint session of both the Houses of the Parliament?Speaker

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Joint sitting presided by Lok Sabha Speaker (Art 118(4)); if absent → Deputy Speaker → Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha → person chosen by members present. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Don't confuse Not the President or Vice-President; the Rajya Sabha Chairman never presides over a joint sitting.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 10 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Consider the following statements:1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Joint sitting (Art 108): 1st in 1961 (Dowry Prohibition Bill); 2nd in 1978 (Banking Service Commission (Repeal) Bill, 1977); 3rd in March 2002 (POTA). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Memory aid D-B-P order: Dowry, Banking, POTA.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Joint Session of both the Houses of Parliament is concernedonly 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Joint session (Art 108) → only to pass a Bill on which the two Houses disagree; not for President/VP elections or Constitution amendment; first on Dowry Bill. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A deadlock between the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha calls for a joint sitting of the Parliament during the passage ofOnly 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Joint sitting (Art 108) → only for ordinary legislation; Money Bill needs none (Rajya Sabha must return it in 14 days); Constitution Amendment passed by each House (Art 368). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Don't confuse Joint sitting is never for Money Bills or Constitution Amendment Bills.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Money Bill has been defined by the Constitution under Article:110

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Article 110 → definition of Money Bill; Art 109 → special procedure for Money Bills; Art 111 → assent to Bills. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Don't confuse 109 (procedure) with 110 (definition).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Who certifies the money bill?Speaker

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Money Bill certified by Lok Sabha Speaker; his decision is final, not questioned by courts, Parliament or President; endorsed when sent to Rajya Sabha and to President. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which one of the following statements is correct?A Money Bill is introduced in the Lok Sabha.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Money Bill → introduced only in Lok Sabha; Speaker's decision final; no joint session; Rajya Sabha can hold it at most 14 days (Art 109(2)). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Of the following statements, which one is not correct?Money Bill is introduced in the Rajya Sabha.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Not correct: 'Money Bill introduced in Rajya Sabha' → only in Lok Sabha (Art 109(1)); Rajya Sabha returns it, with or without recommendations, within 14 days. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Rajya Sabha can delay the Finance Bill sent for its consideration by Lok Sabha for a maximum period of-Fourteen days

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Rajya Sabha can delay a Money Bill (treated here as 'Finance Bill') for at most fourteen days; an ordinary bill has no time limit. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Vote on Account is meant forAppropriating funds pending passing of budget

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Vote on Account (Art 116(1)(a)) → funds to run the administration pending passage of the full budget, e.g. near elections or before new financial year. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The stages in the normal financial legislation include –1, 2, 3 and 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Normal financial legislation: Budget presentation → discussion → Appropriation Bill → Finance Bill; Vote on Account, vote of credit, exceptional grants (Art 116) are outside it. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Statement(A): N.D.A. Government does not like discussion under Rule 184 of Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha.(A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Rule 184 (Lok Sabha) → discussion followed by voting; government avoids it as a lost vote can threaten it. A and R true, R explains A. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Which one of the following is the largest Committee of the Parliament?The Committee on Estimates

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Largest Parliamentary Committee → Estimates Committee (30 members, all Lok Sabha, first 1950, one-year term); PAC 22 (15 + 7); Public Undertakings 22; Petitions 15. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • How many members are elected from the Lok Sabha for Public Account Committee?15

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Public Accounts Committee → formed every year, not more than 22 members: 15 from Lok Sabha, 7 from Rajya Sabha; scrutinises the CAG's report. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Memory aid PAC = 15 + 7 = 22.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Public Accounts Committee submits its reports to-The Speaker of the Lok Sabha

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            PAC submits its report to the Speaker of Lok Sabha → presented in Lok Sabha; members: 15 (Lok Sabha) + 07 (Rajya Sabha) = 22. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Memory aid PAC formula 15 + 07 = 22; the bigger share and the report both go to Lok Sabha.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Who nominates the Chairman of the Public Accounts Committee of Indian Parliament?The Speaker of Lok Sabha

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Chairman of PAC → appointed by Speaker of Lok Sabha from among its members; till 1966-67 from ruling party, since 1967-68 an opposition member. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Must-know questions: 38

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Hour 61 →

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Hour 61 of 72 · Revise

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Revise: Parliamentary Committees to The State Legislature

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              38 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Cover each line, recall it, then check. Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Members of the Rajya Sabha are not associated with –Only 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Estimates Committee (first 1950) → 30 members, all from Lok Sabha, no Rajya Sabha member; PAC and Public Undertakings Committee → 22 (15 LS + 7 RS). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid Estimates = Exclusively Lok Sabha.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Estimates Committee (30, Lok Sabha only) with PAC (22, both Houses).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Joint Parliamentary Committee examining the 2G Scam is headed byP.C.Chacko

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2G Scam Joint Parliamentary Committee → headed by P.C. Chacko; report given to Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 came into force on:30th January, 1990

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              SC and ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 → President's assent 11 September 1989; came into force 30 January 1990. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Act year is 1989, but it came into force in 1990.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Right to Information Act of Parliament received the assent of the President of India on –15th June, 2005

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              RTI Act → passed Lok Sabha 11 May, Rajya Sabha 12 May 2005; President's assent 15 June 2005; in force 12 October 2005 (after 120 days); a legal right. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The National Green Tribunal Act, 2010 was enacted in consonance with which of the following provisions of the Constitution of India?1 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              National Green Tribunal Act, 2010 → based on right to a healthy environment under Article 21 (Right to Life); NGT established 18.10.2010. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Disaster Management Act was made in2005

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Disaster Management Act → passed 2005; President's assent 23 December 2005; 11 chapters, 79 sections. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The current sanctioned strength of Judges of Supreme Court of India is –—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Supreme Court → Part V, Chapter IV, Article 124; Articles 124 to 147 cover its composition and jurisdiction; in the 1950s it had a Chief Justice and seven Judges. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Supreme Court consists of a Chief Justice and—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Original Constitution (1950) → Supreme Court of a Chief Justice and 7 puisne Judges; Parliament may increase the number (Article 124). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The resignation letter by a Judge of Supreme Court is addressed to:The President

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Supreme Court Judge resigns by writing to the President; appointed by President by warrant under hand and seal; strength: CJI + up to thirty-three Judges (originally seven). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The age of retirement in the Supreme Court is-65 Years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Retirement age → Supreme Court Judges 65 years; High Court Judges 62 years. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid Higher court, higher age: SC 65, HC 62.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Don't mix 65 (Supreme Court) with 62 (High Court).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Acting Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of India is appointed by-President

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Acting Chief Justice of India → appointed by President (Article 126) when CJI post is vacant or CJI cannot act; no additional judges in Supreme Court. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following has recommended that appointment of Judges to Higher Courts should be through the participation of the Executive, Legislature and Chief Justice?Second Administrative Reforms Commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Second Administrative Reforms Commission → recommended appointing higher court Judges with participation of Executive, Legislature and Chief Justice of India. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Ad hoc Judges are appointed in the Supreme Court when–There is no quorum of the Judges available to hold.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Ad hoc Judges in Supreme Court (Article 127(1)) → when quorum is lacking; CJI requests them with President's prior consent, after consulting the High Court's Chief Justice. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The power of the Supreme Court of India to decide disputes between the Centre and the State falls under its–Original jurisdiction

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Centre-State disputes → Supreme Court's original jurisdiction (Article 131), excluding other courts; covers disputes between Government of India and States, and among States. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In which of the following cases, the Supreme Court of India enunciated the ‘Doctrine of Basic Structure’?Keshvanand Bharti

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Basic Structure doctrine → Kesavananda Bharati vs State of Kerala (1973), thirteen-Judge bench, 7:6; Parliament cannot damage basic structure under Article 368. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which Article of the Constitution of India deals with the Appellate Jurisdiction of the Supreme Court in connection with Constitutional Cases?Article 132 read with Article 134 A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Appellate jurisdiction in constitutional cases → Article 132 read with Article 134A (appeals from High Courts); Article 131 → original jurisdiction. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which Article of the Constitution permits the Supreme Court to review its judgement or order?Article 137

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Article 137 → Supreme Court can review its own judgment or order, subject to law made by Parliament and rules under Article 145. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In India, Judicial Review impliesthe power of the Judiciary to pronounce upon the constitutionality of laws and executive orders.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Judicial Review → power of Judiciary to interpret the Constitution and declare laws or executive orders void if they conflict with it. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who has the last authority to explain the Constitution?Supreme Court

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Final authority to interpret the Constitution → Supreme Court; it is the Guardian or Custodian of the Constitution. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following is the custodian of the Constitution of India?The Supreme Court of India

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Custodian / Guardian of the Constitution of India → Supreme Court (not President, PM or Lok Sabha Secretariat). Must know
