                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following cases comes under the Jurisdiction of High Court and Supreme Court?Enforcement of Fundamental Rights.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Enforcement of Fundamental Rights → both Supreme Court (Article 32) and High Courts (Article 226); HC writ power is wider (also other rights). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Who has the right to seek advisory opinion of the Supreme Court on any question of law –President

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Advisory opinion of Supreme Court on a question of law → sought by the President (Article 143), not PM or High Courts. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following statements regarding the Advisory Jurisdiction of the Supreme Court is correct?2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Advisory Jurisdiction (Article 143) → heard by a bench of 5; opinion not binding on government; SC must answer only references on old treaties/agreements, not other questions. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements:2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              V.R. Krishna Iyer → SC judge, never Chief Justice of India; with P.N. Bhagwati, pioneer of PIL (Public Interest Litigation), which lies in both High Courts and Supreme Court. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse PIL = Public Interest Litigation, not Public Inquiry or Public Investment Litigation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The concept of Public Interest Litigation originated in:The United States

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Public Interest Litigation → originated in the United States (legal aid movement; first legal aid office in New York, 1876). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Not India or UK: the PIL concept began in the United States.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The original plan in the draft Constitution for having elected Governors was dropped because1, 3 and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Elected Governor plan dropped → it meant another election; elected Governor might feel superior to CM; Governor works under Parliamentary System. Governor is appointed by President. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 8 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following statements in relation to Governor of a State in India -2 and 4 are correct

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Governor (Article 157) → Indian citizen (birth not required), at least 35 years; not member of either House (Article 158); can be Governor of two or more States. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Consider the following and select the correct answer by using the code given below:(1), (3) and (4)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Governor's oath (Article 159) → before Chief Justice of the High Court, or in his absence senior-most Judge; oath form is in Article 159, not Third Schedule. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Governor's oath form is in Article 159 itself, not in the Third Schedule.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following is not correctly matched?Article 155 – Removal of the Governor

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Article 153 → Governor for each State; 154 → executive power; 155 → appointment (not removal); 156 → term of office. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid 153 office, 154 power, 155 appointment, 156 term: the Governor's story in order.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following statements about the Governor of an Indian State is not true:He can be removed earlier if the Legislature of the concerned State passes a resolution for his removal.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Governor → appointed by President, can govern more than one State, five-year term at President's pleasure (Article 156(1)); State Legislature cannot remove him. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • To whom is the Governor of a State responsible?President

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Governor → responsible to the President; holds office at President's pleasure (Article 156(1)), in effect the Union Government; term five years (Article 156(3)). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • By which time Governor has to return an ordinary bill to the concerned State Legislature for reconsideration?No time limit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Article 200 → Governor can return an ordinary bill (not money bill) for reconsideration or reserve it for President; no time limit fixed for returning it. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Don't confuse Don't pick one or three months: the Constitution fixes no time limit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which among the following Articles of the Indian Constitution empowers the Governor to issue the ordinance?Art. 213

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Article 213 → Governor promulgates ordinances during recess of Legislature; must be laid before State Legislature and approved by it, else it ceases to operate. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The first lady to become Governor of a State in India -Sarojini Naidu

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              First woman Governor of a State → Sarojini Naidu, Governor of Uttar Pradesh (United Province) after Independence; died in office in 1949. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • What is the right method to establish or cancel the second chamber in states?Proposal in Legislative Assembly with full majority along with law passed by Parliament

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Create/abolish State Legislative Council (Article 169) → Assembly resolution by majority of total membership and two-thirds present and voting, then a law by Parliament. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 8 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • How many members are nominated in the Legislative Council of Uttar Pradesh by the State Governor?1/10 of the total members

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              UP Legislative Council → Governor nominates 1/10 of members (per book); nominees have special knowledge of literature, science, arts, co-operative movement, social service (Article 171(3)). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which one of the following cannot be dissolved but can be abolished?State Legislative Councils

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              State Legislative Council → cannot be dissolved but can be abolished (Article 169); member's tenure 6 years. Rajya Sabha: neither; Lok Sabha and Assemblies: dissolved, not abolished. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Memory aid Council: abolish yes, dissolve no; Rajya Sabha: neither.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Which of the following States does not have Bicameral Legislature?Tamil Nadu

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Tamil Nadu, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh → unicameral; Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka, Bihar, Maharashtra → bicameral (have Legislative Council). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Must-know questions: 36

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Hour 62 →

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Hour 62 of 72 · Revise

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Revise: The State Legislature to Lokpal and Important Commissions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                38 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Cover each line, recall it, then check. Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • According to Article 170 of the Indian Constitution, the minimum and maximum strength of members of Legislative Assembly in a state can be respectively:60 and 500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Article 170 → State Legislative Assembly: minimum 60, maximum 500 members, directly elected; Sikkim is an exception. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid Assembly size: 60 to 500.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements: The Constitution of India provides that2 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                State Assembly → not more than 500 members, not 450 (Article 170(1)); minimum age to be chosen to the Assembly → 25 years. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • A bill other than Money Bill which is passed by Legislative Assembly for the first time, may remain pending in the legislative council for how many months?For not more than three months

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Ordinary bill passed by Assembly → Legislative Council can hold it 3 months first time (Article 197), about 4 months in all; Vidhan Sabha Speaker decides Money Bill. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Select the Constitutional Duties of the Chief Minister from the following by using the code given below:(1), (2) and (4)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Article 167 → CM's duties: communicate to Governor all Council of Ministers' decisions on State affairs and legislative proposals; furnish information the Governor calls for. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which Indian state had the first woman Chief Minister?U.P.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                First woman Chief Minister of an Indian State → Sucheta Kriplani, Uttar Pradesh, 1963. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The salaries and allowances of the Judges of the High Court are charged to the:Consolidated Fund of the State

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                High Court Judges' salaries and allowances → Consolidated Fund of the State (Article 202(3)(d)); their pensions → Consolidated Fund of India (Article 112(3)(d)). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid Salary from the State, pension from India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In which part of the Indian Constitution, legislative relations between Centre and States are given?Part XI

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Legislative relations → Part XI, Articles 245-255; Seventh Schedule lists: Union 97 (now 98), State 66 (now 59), Concurrent 47 (now 52) subjects. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The distribution of legislative powers between the Centre and the States in the Constitution is given in –Seventh Schedule

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Distribution of legislative powers between Centre and States (Union, State, Concurrent Lists) → Seventh Schedule; Article 246. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which Article among the following says that Indian Constitution provisions about interstate relation?Article 263

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Article 263 → Inter-State Council to coordinate Centre-State and inter-state relations; established by the President; its source is the Constitution. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The regional councils are constituted by–Parliamentary Laws

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Zonal (regional) Councils → made by Parliamentary law (Act of 1956): five councils (North, South, Central, East, West); North East council 1971; Union Home Minister chairs each. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Sarkaria Commission was set up to review –The relations between the Union and the States

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Sarkaria Commission → review of Union-State relations; set up 9 June 1983 under Justice R.S. Sarkaria; other members B. Shivaraman and Dr. S.R. Sen. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In which one of the following years was Sarkaria Commission, which was empowered to recommend changes in Centre-State relations submitted its report?None of the above/More than one of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Sarkaria Commission (Centre-State relations) report year is none of 1983, 1984, 1985, 1987 → 'None of the above'; BPSC's key (d) was wrong. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid Set up in 1983; report came in January, after all the listed years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Under which of the following taxes the total amount payable by an individual is limited by the Constitution?Tax on profession, trade, and callings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Tax on professions, trades, callings and employments → Constitution caps it at Rs 2,500 per person per year [Art 276(2)]; raised from Rs 250 by 60th Amendment, 1988. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Under which Article of the Constitution it is the responsibility of the Indian Government to protect States from external aggression and internal disturbance?Article 355

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Art 355 → Union's duty to protect States from external aggression and internal disturbance; Art 352 → National Emergency. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Don't confuse Art 355 (Union's duty to protect States) with Art 356 (President's Rule).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The President of India may declare the National Emergency if there is the threat of:1 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                National Emergency (Art 352) grounds → war, external aggression, armed rebellion; 'internal disturbance' replaced by 'armed rebellion' (44th Amendment, 1978). Communal clashes not a ground. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Under which of the following circumstances can the President declare Emergency?1, 3, and 4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                President can declare Emergency for external aggression (Art 352), failure of state constitutional machinery (Art 356) and financial crisis (Art 360); internal disturbance no longer a ground. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following is the time limit for the ratification of an Emergency period by the Parliament?1 month

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Emergency proclamation (Art 352) → must be approved by both Houses within one month, or it ceases to operate. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The President of India has the power to suspend the—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Emergency → Art 19 auto-suspended (Art 358, war/external aggression); President can suspend other FRs incl. Art 21A (Art 359); Arts 20 and 21 never suspended. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution has not so far been used?Article 360

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Article 360 (Financial Emergency) → never used so far; Articles 352 and 356 have been used. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid Art 360, like 360 degrees, brings you back to zero: zero uses.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Generally, in India Finance Commission is appointed for every five years-To determine the share of the States in the grants and revenues of the Central Government.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Finance Commission (Art 280) → set up by President every fifth year; recommends sharing of net tax proceeds between Union and States; first one 6 April 1952 under K.C. Neogy. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which of the following recommends the principles for sharing of revenues among the Union and the States?Finance Commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Principles for sharing revenue between Union and States → Finance Commission, constituted every 5 years. Inter-State Council → coordination; Planning Commission (now NITI Aayog) → resource allocation. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements: The function (s) of the Finance Commission is/are –2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Finance Commission → divides net tax proceeds among States; sets principles for grants-in-aid. Not its job: withdrawal from Consolidated Fund (Parliament) or checking tax collection (Finance Ministry). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Federal Finance Commission in India relates to –Finances between States and the Centre

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Federal Finance Commission → finances between the Centre and the States; it recommends distribution of finance between Union and States. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • After the commencement of the Constitution how many Finance Commissions have been constituted?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Finance Commission chairmen: 13th → Vijay Kelkar; 14th → Y.V. Reddy (formed January 2013); 15th → N.K. Singh (constituted 27 November 2017). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following statements about a State Finance Commission is true?It is a Constitutional body.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                State Finance Commission → a constitutional body, constituted by the Governor under Article 243-I. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Planning Commission has been abolished by Prime MinisterNarendra Modi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Planning Commission (March 1950, Nehru) → abolished by PM Narendra Modi (announced 15 August 2014); NITI Aayog set up 1 January 2015 by Union Cabinet resolution. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Who appoints the Vice Chairman of NITI Aayog?The Prime Minister of India.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NITI Aayog Vice-Chairperson → appointed by the Prime Minister (Cabinet Minister rank); first was Dr. Arvind Pangariya (January 2015 to August 2017); PM is ex-officio chairman. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • When was the Planning Commission established?15th March, 1950

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Planning Commission → set up 15 March 1950 by Union Cabinet resolution (non-constitutional). NITI Aayog → also extra-constitutional, from 1 January 2015. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Which one of the following is not a Constitutional body?Planning Commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Planning Commission → not a constitutional body (executive order, 1950). UPSC and State PSCs (Art 315) and Finance Commission (Art 280) are constitutional. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 8 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Who was the First Chairman of Planning Commission of India?Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                First Chairman of Planning Commission → Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru, as the Prime Minister was its ex-officio Chairman (set up 15 March 1950). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission is equivalent to-Cabinet Minister

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Deputy Chairman of Planning Commission → rank of a Cabinet Minister; first Deputy Chairman was Gulzarilal Nanda. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The National Development Council (NDC) –1, 2, and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NDC → gives guidelines for the National Plan, considers it, reviews progress and suggests ways to meet its goals; allocating money was the Planning Commission's job. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • National Development Council is primarily related to –Approval of five-year plans

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NDC → final approval of five-year plans; set up 6 August 1952 by executive order; PM presides; Planning Commission Secretary is its Secretary; coordinates Planning Commission and States. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Indian Model of Ombudsman is –Lokpal

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Indian Ombudsman → Lokpal; Ombudsman began in Sweden (1809). First ARC (Morarji Desai) recommended Lokpal, Lokayukta and a Local Body Ombudsman. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Memory aid Ombudsman is a Swedish idea: Sweden, 1809.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Vohra Committee was formed to study-Nexus of Politicians and Criminals

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Vohra Committee (1993) → nexus of criminals, politicians and bureaucrats (criminalisation of politics). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Read the following and select the correct answer from the code given below:Both (A) and (R) are false.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NHRC Chairman → former CJI or a Supreme Court Judge (2019 Amendment); term 3 years or age 70 → A ('only former CJI') and R ('5 years') both false. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Who presides over the committee constituted for the appointment of members of the State Human Rights Commission?The Chief Minister

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                SHRC selection committee (Section 22, Act 1993) → chaired by Chief Minister; Governor is not on it, he only appoints. Must know
