                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Consider the following statements regarding appointment of National Commission for revising the Constitution-1 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                National Commission to Review the Working of the Constitution → 22 February 2000, Justice M.N. Venkatachaliah; recommendatory; not approved by Parliament; last report 31 March 2002. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Must-know questions: 36

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Hour 63 →

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Hour 63 of 72 · Revise

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Revise: Lokpal and Important Commissions to Panchayati Raj and Community Development

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  38 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Cover each line, recall it, then check. Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Union Public Service Commission submits its annual report to the –President

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  UPSC annual report → to the President (Art 323); laid before each House with a memorandum on cases where its advice was not accepted. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A joint state public service commission may be established for two or more states.Both (a) and (b)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Joint State PSC [Art 315(2)] → when two or more States agree (resolution by each House of their legislatures) and Parliament provides for it by law → both. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which Article of the Constitution has provision for removal of a member of Public Service Commission?317

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Removal of a PSC Chairman or member → Article 317: by President on ground of misbehaviour, after Supreme Court inquiry on President's reference (Art 145 procedure). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid 315 create, 316 appoint, 317 remove: count up the life of a PSC member.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which Article of the Constitution prescribes mandatory consultation with RPSC on disciplinary matters affecting a person serving under Government of Rajasthan?Article 320(3)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Mandatory PSC consultation on disciplinary matters of civil servants → Art 320(3)(c). Art 318 → service regulations; Art 322 → expenses; Art 325 → elections. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Union Public Service Commission can be entrusted with the functions of a State Public Service Commission with the approval of –President of India

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  UPSC can serve a State's needs → if the Governor requests, with approval of the President [Art 315(4)]. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Article 370 of Indian Constitution is –A Temporary and Transitional Provision

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Article 370 (Jammu and Kashmir) → a temporary and transitional provision; abrogated 6 August 2019. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Constitution of India provides for an Election Commission under Article –324

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Election Commission → Article 324: superintendence, direction and control of electoral rolls and elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, President and Vice-President. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Consider the following statements:(i) and (ii)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  CEC → salary equal to SC Judge; term 6 years or age 65, whichever first; resignation addressed to the President, not to the CEC → (i) and (ii) correct. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Given below are two statements:Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not a correct explanation of (A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Elections entrusted to independent Election Commission (Art 324) (A true); CEC removed like SC Judge, other ECs by President with CEC's advice (R true); R doesn't explain A. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The functions of Election Commission of India are-I, II and IV

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Election Commission [Art 324(1)] → electoral rolls and elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, President, Vice-President; it does not recommend President's Rule or make election laws. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following are the functions of the Election Commissioner of India?None of the above

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Not ECI's work: electing Speaker, Deputy Speaker, Deputy Chairman (done by House members); municipal polls (State Election Commission, Art 243ZA); election disputes (judiciary) → none. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Who decides disputes regarding disqualification of Members of Parliament?The President in consultation with the Election Commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Disqualification of MPs → decided by the President after obtaining the Election Commission's opinion and acting on it (Article 103). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Right to Vote and to be Elected in India is a-Legal Right

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Right to vote and to be elected in India → a legal right (not fundamental, constitutional or natural). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Voting right by the youths at the age of 18 years was exercised for the first time in the General Election of1989

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Voting age 21 → 18 by 61st Amendment Act, 1988 (in force 28 March 1989); first used in the November 1989 Lok Sabha general election. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid Law in 1988, first vote in 1989.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 9 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Given below are two statements, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Proportional representation → represents all groups (ethnicity, gender, interests, ideologies), so it eases minority representation; A and R true, R explains A. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following is the “National Voters’ Day”?25th January

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  National Voters' Day → 25 January (Election Commission's foundation day), celebrated since 25 January 2011 to draw young voters. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A party gets recognition as a national party when –—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  National party → any one: 2% Lok Sabha seats from three states; or 6% votes in four states + four Lok Sabha seats; or State party in four states. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A political party is recognized as a regional party, ifIt gets 8% votes in the State either in Lok Sabha or the Assembly election.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  State party (Symbols Order 1968) → any one: 3 Assembly seats or 3%; 1 Lok Sabha seat per 25; 6% votes + seats; or 8% of total State votes. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse UPPSC's key said 'None of the above'; the book holds 8% (option c).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Consider the following statements:Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  No fixed party system in India (A) because there are too many parties (R) → both true, R explains A; casteism, regionalism and socio-economic factors also add parties. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which one of the following Bills must be passed by each House of the Indian Parliament separately by the special majority?Constitution Amendment Bill

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Constitution Amendment Bill (Article 368) → must be passed by each House separately by special majority, then presented to the President for assent. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Amendments to the Constitution may be initiated-Either House of the Parliament

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Amendment Bill → introduced in either House of Parliament [Art 368(2)], not in State legislatures; special majority in each House; procedure taken from South Africa. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • According to the Indian Constitution, the Constitutional amendment of the following topics requires consent of at least half of State legislatures1, 2, 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Ratification by half the States needed for → federal provisions, Supreme Court and High Courts, Art 368 itself. New States, boundaries, names → simple majority of Parliament. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The First Constitution Amendment Bill passed in 1951 was related toProtection of agrarian reforms in certain States

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  First Amendment, 1951 → protection of agrarian (land) reforms in certain States; added Arts 31A, 31B and the Ninth Schedule. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following has banned floor crossing by the member elected on a party ticket to the legislature?52nd Constitutional Amendment Act

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  52nd Amendment Act, 1985 → Anti-Defection Law (ban on floor crossing); added the 10th Schedule; later amended by the 91st Amendment Act, 2003. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse 52nd (1985, brought anti-defection law) with 91st (2003, which only amended it).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which Constitution Amendment Act reduced the voting age from 21 years to 18 years?61st Amendment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  61st Amendment → voting age for Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assembly elections cut from 21 years to 18 years. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • By Which one of the following Constitutional Amendments Delhi became ‘National Capital Region’?69th Amendment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  69th Amendment Act, 1991 → Delhi got the status of National Capital Territory (NCT). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The 79 Amendment of the Indian Constitution is related to –Reservation of SCs and STs in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  79th Amendment (1999) → extended SC/ST and Anglo-Indian seat reservation in Lok Sabha and State Assemblies by 10 years; 95th Amendment (2009) extended it another 10 years. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ‘Right to Education’ introduced through 86 Amendment came into force:In 2010

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  86th Amendment Act, 2002 → Art 21A (Right to Education); RTE Act passed 2009; both came into force on 1 April 2010. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse Three dates: amendment 2002, RTE Act 2009, in force 2010 — 'came into force' means 2010.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which Amendment to the Constitution inserted a new Article 21 A in the Constitution providing Right to Education?86th Amendment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  86th Amendment Act, 2002 → new Article 21-A: free and compulsory education for all children aged 6-14 as a Fundamental Right. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid 21-A sits right after Art 21 (life): education grows out of the right to life.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The 91 Amendment of the Indian Constitution providesceiling of the size of Council of Ministers

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  91st Amendment (2003) → ceiling on the size of the Council of Ministers (15% of the House) via Art 75(1A), to strengthen the anti-defection law. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • 97th Constitutional Amendment Act of2012 is concerned with……….Organization and working of co-operative societies

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  97th Amendment (notified 12 January 2012) → cooperative societies: added to Art 19(1)(c), new Art 43B and Part IX-B (Arts 243ZH to 243ZT). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In which case(s) did the Supreme Court of India give for the first time the doctrine of ‘basic structure’ of the Constitution?Kesavananda Bharati vs. State of Kerala

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Basic structure doctrine first given in Kesavananda Bharati vs State of Kerala (1973); it reversed Golak Nath and upheld the 24th Amendment. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid K for Kesavananda = K for 'Keystone': the basic structure holds up the arch.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Parliament can amend the provision on official language of India under the Constitution by—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Official language (Part XVII, Articles 343 to 351): Articles 343, 344, 346, 348 amended only by Article 368(2) special majority; Official Language Act 1963 (English use) by simple majority. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which Article of the Constitution provides that every state shall endeavour to provide an adequate facility for instruction in mother-tongue at primary stage of education?Article 350-A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Art 350A → every State and local authority to provide mother-tongue teaching at primary stage for linguistic-minority children; President may issue directions (added by 7th Amendment). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which of the following languages was added in the eighth schedule of the Constitution in 2003?Santhali

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  92nd Amendment (2003) added Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, Santhali; Schedule now 22 (Sindhi by 21st, 1967; Konkani, Manipuri, Nepali by 71st, 1992); Bhojpuri not included. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Memory aid 2003 four: 'Bo-Do-Ma-San' — Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, Santhali.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 6 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The number of official languages recognised by the constitution in the eight schedule is………—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Eighth Schedule languages: 18 before the 92nd Amendment Act, 2003; 22 after it (none of the printed options fits today). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Which Article of the Indian Constitution directs state Government to organize village Panchayats?Article 40

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Art 40 (Directive Principles) → State shall organise village Panchayats and give them powers to work as units of self-government. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Panchayati Raj is organized as a unit of Self Government under –73rd Amendment of the Indian Constitution

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  73rd Amendment (1992) → gave Panchayati Raj constitutional status as a unit of self-government; this third tier was added to the federal system in 1993. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Don't confuse DPSP only directed States to form Panchayats; constitutional status came from the 73rd Amendment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Must-know questions: 35

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Hour 64 →

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Hour 64 of 72 · Revise

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Revise: Panchayati Raj and Community Development to Miscellaneous

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    33 Must-know facts. Say each one aloud before you read it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Cover each line, recall it, then check. Answer the questions below.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • W h i c h C o n s t i t u t i o n a l A m e n d m e n t g r a n t e d Constitutional Status to Panchayati Raj Institutions?73rd Amendment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    73rd Amendment, 1992 → constitutional status to Panchayati Raj; inserted Part IX and the 11th Schedule; in force 24 April 1993. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    73rd Amendment (1992, in force 24 April 1993) → watershed: Part IX gave Panchayats constitutional status; 73rd and 74th Amendments came under PM P.V. Narsimha Rao. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 73rd Amendment of the Constitution has provided for:All the four

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    73rd Amendment → regular Panchayat elections (Art 243K), at least one-third seats for women (243D), funds via State Finance Commission (243I), 29 subjects of 11th Schedule. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • If a Panchayat is dissolved, elections are to be held within–six months

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Dissolved Panchayat → election before 6 months from dissolution (Art 243E); normal term five years from first meeting. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Consider the following statements -1 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Statement 1 true: Part IX (Panchayats) inserted by 73rd Amendment Act, 1992 (in force 24 April 1993). Statement 2 false: Art 243-Q does not envisage only two municipality types. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • According to Constitutional Provisions the decision to hold Panchayat elections is taken by -State Government

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Decision to hold Panchayat elections → State Government (Art 243K); Panchayati Raj is a State List subject. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Don't pick the State Election Commission or the Election Commission of India: the decision rests with the State Government.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 7 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Assertion (A): Reservation in the Office of Pradhans, P r a m u kh s a n d A d h y a ks h a s i n Panchayats for women including SCs, STs and OBCs has brought about a distinct change in their working.A is true but (R) is false.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A true, R false: women's reservation as Pradhan, Pramukh, Adhyaksha changed their working; it was not a long-standing demand. Art 243-D: not less than one-third seats for women. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following was not proposed by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment in context to Panchayati Raj?—

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    73rd Amendment: women get one-third (not 30%) of seats; no two-child disqualification. It did provide State Finance Commissions and elections within six months of dissolution. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In India, seats are reserved for women in –Panchayati Raj Institutions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Women's reservation: Panchayati Raj bodies (Art 243-D, one-third); later 106th Amendment, 2023 (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam) → one-third in Lok Sabha, State Assemblies, Delhi Assembly. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • When was the Panchayats (Extension to the Scheduled Areas) Act passed by Indian Parliament?1996

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    PESA (Panchayats Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act → passed 1996 on Bhuria Committee recommendations; applies to Fifth Schedule areas in ten States. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The fundamental object of Panchayati Raj system is to ensure which among the following?1 and 3 only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Basic aim of Panchayati Raj → people's participation in development + democratic decentralisation; began 2 October 1959, Nagaur (Rajasthan); constitutional status by 73rd Amendment, 1992. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following statements regarding Panchayati Raj is not correct?73rd Amendment came into effect on 15th August, 1993.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Wrong: '73rd Amendment came into effect on 15 August 1993' — correct date is 24 April 1993. Art 243-G (Panchayat powers) adds to its importance. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Name the Committee which was set up by the NDC in 1957 for the reorganization of CDP and NES, which suggested a three-tier system of rural local government-Balwant Rai Mehta Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (set up by NDC, 1957) → reviewed CDP (1952) and NES (1953); recommended three-tier Panchayati Raj; Rajasthan first to adopt it. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid Balwant = 'bal' (strength) of three tiers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 10 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer from the code given below the lists:2 1 4 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Balwant Rai Mehta (1957) → three-tier; Ashok Mehta (1977, report 1978) → two-tier; G.V.K.
