Rao (1985) → better representative character; L.M. Singhvi → local self-government system. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid Balwant 3 tiers, Ashok 2 tiers: the later Mehta cut one tier.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The Panchayati Raj System was first started in India in the State of Rajasthan and ..................Andhra Pradesh

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Panchayati Raj first started in Rajasthan (Nagaur, 2 October 1959, by Nehru), then in Andhra Pradesh (second State). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid R before A: Rajasthan first, Andhra second; Nagaur opened on Gandhi Jayanti.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 17 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following committees is not concerned with Panchayati Raj Institution?P.V.N. Rao Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Not a PRI committee: P.V.N. Rao. PRI committees: Balwant Rai Mehta 1957 → Ashok Mehta 1977 → C.H. Hanumantha Rao 1983 → G.V.K. Rao 1985 → L.M. Singhvi 1986. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid Order B-A-H-G-S: 'Big Ashok Has Good Sense'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 8 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which model was recommended by Ashok Mehta Committee for Panchayati Raj System?Two-tier

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Ashok Mehta Committee (1977, report August 1978) → two-tier Panchayati Raj: Zila Parishad (district) and Mandal Panchayat (village group, 15000 to 20000 people). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following Committees recommended to give Constitutional status to Panchayati Raj?L.M. Singhvi Committee

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    L.M. Singhvi Committee (1986) → constitutional recognition and protection for local self-government; no political parties in Panchayat elections. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid Singhvi = Samvidhan: both start with S — constitutional status.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which part of our Constitution envisages a three-tier system of Panchayats?Part IX

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Part IX (Art 243-B) → three-tier Panchayats: village, intermediate, district; intermediate tier optional in States with population not over twenty lakh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following have been covered by 73rd Amendment of the Constitution?Only 1, 2 and 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    73rd Amendment → Gram, Kshetra and Zila Panchayat; Nagar Panchayat, Nagar Palika Parishad and Nagar Nigam come under the 74th Amendment Act, 1992. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Don't confuse Nagar Panchayat sounds rural but is an urban body — it falls under the 74th Amendment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following States does not have any Panchayati Raj Institution?Nagaland

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    No Panchayati Raj Institutions in Mizoram, Nagaland and Meghalaya (per the book); Assam, Kerala, Tripura have them. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid 'M-N-M' trio without Panchayats: Mizoram, Nagaland, Meghalaya.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The members of the Panchayat Samiti are –Directly elected by the people.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Panchayat Samiti → intermediate (block) level; members directly elected by the people; called Kshetra Panchayat in Uttar Pradesh. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which one of the following was established as the first programme of community development?National Extension Service

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    First community development programme (book answer) → National Extension Service; CDP (1952) had three phases: National Extension, Intensive Community Development Project, Post Intensive Development. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • All elections to the Panchayats are conducted by-State Election Commission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    All Panchayat elections → State Election Commission (Art 243K); Municipal elections also SEC (Art 243ZA); State Election Commissioner appointed by the Governor. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • For election to the Panchayat, the State Election Commissioner will be appointed byGovernor of the State

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    State Election Commissioner (Panchayat elections, Art 243K) → appointed by the Governor of the State. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following are Constitutional Authorities? Select the correct answer using code given below:1,2 and 3 Only

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Constitutional authorities: State Election Commission (Art 243K), State Finance Commission (243I), District Panchayat (243B); State/Chief Electoral Officer is not. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which of the following Constitutional Amendment Acts accorded Constitutional Status to the Municipalities?The Constitution (74 Amendment) Act, 1992 th

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    74th Amendment, 1992 → constitutional status to Municipalities (urban local bodies): Part IX-A (Arts 243P-243ZG) and the 12th Schedule. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid 73 = gaon (village), 74 = shahar (town): one number up, one step up to the town.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 4 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The Authority to specify as to which castes shall be deemed to be Scheduled Castes rests with the–President

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Art 341 → President (after consulting the Governor, for a State) notifies which castes are Scheduled Castes in a State/UT. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The Provision of National Commission for Scheduled Tribes is given in which Article of the Constitution?Article 338A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Art 338A → National Commission for Scheduled Tribes; Art 338 → National Commission for Scheduled Castes; split by the 89th Amendment Act, 2003. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 5 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • What s the position of representation of Anglo-Indian Community in Lok Sabha?Nomination of them has been done away with by 104th Constitutional Amendment

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Anglo-Indian nomination to Lok Sabha (Art 331: President could nominate two) → done away with by the 104th Amendment. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • World’s main languages are –Hindi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    UN's six official languages → English, French, Spanish, Arabic, Chinese, Russian (working languages: English, French); Hindi is not one. Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Memory aid 'FACERS': French, Arabic, Chinese, English, Russian, Spanish.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 3 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The headquarters of International Court of Justice is situated at:Hague

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    International Court of Justice → set up June 1945; headquarters at The Hague (Netherlands). Must know

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Full question and explanation · 2 paper(s)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Meaning of Extra-Constitutional Right -That power which is not in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Extra-constitutional power → one not found in the Constitution's provisions; e.g., Planning Commission, made by a Cabinet resolution, yet it wielded power over Centre and States. Must know
